AI.method: 提出LSLORA（限制LoRA适应到通过新的正确性差异隐藏状态指标识别的层）和GARFA（GQA感知的RoPE频率适应，为每个目标层附加8个可学习的每KV头标量乘数），在Llama 3.1 8B模型上进行4路跨层消融实验。
AI.result: 发现强烈的反共定位现象：任务敏感层集中在网络后期（ℓ∈{23-31}），而RoPE影响层集中在网络早期（ℓ∈{0-9}），Spearman相关系数rs = -0.735（p = 1.66×10^-6）。然而，在敏感层同时应用两种干预仍能超越所有其他配置，在六个基准测试上提升4-16个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 尽管存在反共定位现象，但针对任务敏感层同时应用LSLORA和GARFA干预是最有效的策略，能以100美元的计算成本在HumanEval+上接近Claude 3.5 Haiku的性能（67.1% vs. 68.3%）。

title: Multi-Agent Orchestration for High-Throughput Materials Screening on a Leadership-Class System
summary: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) with High-Performance Computing (HPC) is transforming scientific workflows from human-directed pipelines into adaptive systems capable of autonomous decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) play a critical role in autonomous workflows; however, deploying LLM-based agents at scale remains a significant challenge. Single-agent architectures and sequential tool calls often become serialization bottlenecks when executing large-scale simulation campaigns, failing to utilize the massive parallelism of exascale resources. To address this, we present a scalable, hierarchical multi-agent framework for orchestrating high-throughput screening campaigns. Our planner-executor architecture employs a central planning agent to dynamically partition workloads and assign subtasks to a swarm of parallel executor agents. All executor agents interface with a shared Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that orchestrates tasks via the Parsl workflow engine. To demonstrate this framework, we employed the open-weight gpt-oss-120b model to orchestrate a high-throughput screening of the Computation-Ready Experimental (CoRE) Metal-Organic Framework (MOF) database for atmospheric water harvesting. The results demonstrate that the proposed agentic framework enables efficient and scalable execution on the Aurora supercomputer, with low orchestration overhead and high task completion rates. This work establishes a flexible paradigm for LLM-driven scientific automation on HPC systems, with broad applicability to materials discovery and beyond.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种可扩展的分层多智能体框架，用于在HPC系统上协调高通量筛选活动，通过规划-执行架构解决LLM智能体在大规模并行计算中的瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: AI与HPC的融合正在将科学工作流从人工导向转变为自适应系统，但LLM智能体在大规模部署时面临挑战。单智能体架构和顺序工具调用在执行大规模模拟活动时成为串行化瓶颈，无法充分利用百亿亿次计算资源的巨大并行性。
AI.method: 提出了一种可扩展的分层多智能体框架，采用规划-执行架构：中央规划智能体动态划分工作负载并将子任务分配给并行执行智能体群。所有执行智能体通过共享的模型上下文协议(MCP)服务器与Parsl工作流引擎交互。
AI.result: 使用开源的gpt-oss-120b模型协调了计算就绪实验金属有机框架(CoRE MOF)数据库的高通量筛选，用于大气水收集。该框架在Aurora超级计算机上实现了高效可扩展的执行，具有低协调开销和高任务完成率。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为HPC系统上的LLM驱动科学自动化建立了一个灵活的范式，在材料发现等领域具有广泛适用性。

title: Symbiotic-MoE: Unlocking the Synergy between Generation and Understanding
summary: Empowering Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) with image generation often leads to catastrophic forgetting in understanding tasks due to severe gradient conflicts. While existing paradigms like Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) mitigate this conflict through structural isolation, they fundamentally sever cross-modal synergy and suffer from capacity fragmentation. In this work, we present Symbiotic-MoE, a unified pre-training framework that resolves task interference within a native multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers architecture with zero-parameter overhead. We first identify that standard MoE tuning leads to routing collapse, where generative gradients dominate expert utilization. To address this, we introduce Modality-Aware Expert Disentanglement, which partitions experts into task-specific groups while utilizing shared experts as a multimodal semantic bridge. Crucially, this design allows shared experts to absorb fine-grained visual semantics from generative tasks to enrich textual representations. To optimize this, we propose a Progressive Training Strategy featuring differential learning rates and early-stage gradient shielding. This mechanism not only shields pre-trained knowledge from early volatility but eventually transforms generative signals into constructive feedback for understanding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Symbiotic-MoE achieves rapid generative convergence while unlocking cross-modal synergy, boosting inherent understanding with remarkable gains on MMLU and OCRBench.

AI.tldr: Symbiotic-MoE：一个统一的预训练框架，通过模态感知专家解耦和渐进训练策略，在原生多模态MoE Transformer架构中解决图像生成与理解任务间的冲突，实现零参数开销的跨模态协同。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如Mixture-of-Transformers）通过结构隔离缓解梯度冲突，但割裂了跨模态协同并导致容量碎片化。需要一种能在统一架构中解决任务干扰、保持跨模态协同的方法。
AI.method: 1. 模态感知专家解耦：将专家划分为任务特定组，同时使用共享专家作为多模态语义桥梁；2. 渐进训练策略：采用差异化学习率和早期梯度屏蔽，保护预训练知识并将生成信号转化为理解任务的反馈。
AI.result: Symbiotic-MoE实现了快速生成收敛，同时解锁跨模态协同，显著提升了理解能力，在MMLU和OCRBench等基准上取得了显著增益。
AI.conclusion: Symbiotic-MoE框架成功解决了大型多模态模型中图像生成与理解任务间的冲突，在统一架构中实现了跨模态协同，为多模态模型的平衡发展提供了有效解决方案。

title: TEMPER: Testing Emotional Perturbation in Quantitative Reasoning
summary: Large language models are trained and evaluated on quantitative reasoning tasks written in clean, emotionally neutral language. However, real-world queries are often wrapped in frustration, urgency or enthusiasm. Does emotional framing alone degrade reasoning when all numerical content is preserved? To investigate this, a controlled emotion translation framework is developed that rewrites problems into emotional variants while preserving all quantities and relationships. Using this framework, Temper-5400 (5,400 semantically verified emotion--neutral pairs) is constructed across GSM8K, MultiArith, and ARC-Challenge, and evaluated on eighteen models (1B to frontier scale). Two core results emerge: First, emotional framing reduces accuracy by 2-10 percentage points even though all numerical content is preserved. Second, neutralizing emotional variants recovers most of the lost performance, showing both that the degradation is tied to emotional style rather than content corruption and that neutralization can serve as a lightweight inference-time mitigation. Non-emotional paraphrases cause no such degradation, implicating emotional content rather than surface-level changes. Beyond emotion specifically, the benchmark construction procedure provides a general framework for controlled stylistic translation and robustness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 情感表达会降低大语言模型的数学推理能力，即使数值内容完全保留。通过情感翻译框架构建的Temper-5400基准测试显示，情感化表述使模型准确率下降2-10个百分点，而情感中和能恢复大部分性能损失。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索情感表达对大型语言模型数学推理能力的影响。现实世界中的查询常常包含情感色彩（如沮丧、紧迫或热情），而现有模型主要在情感中性的文本上进行训练和评估。研究者想知道：当所有数值内容保持不变时，仅情感框架是否会影响模型的推理能力。
AI.method: 开发了受控情感翻译框架，将数学问题重写为情感化变体，同时保留所有数量和关系。使用该框架构建了Temper-5400数据集，包含5,400个经过语义验证的情感-中性对，覆盖GSM8K、MultiArith和ARC-Challenge三个数据集。在18个模型（从1B参数到前沿规模）上进行了评估，并测试了情感中和作为推理时缓解策略的效果。
AI.result: 两个核心结果：1）情感框架即使保留所有数值内容，仍会使准确率降低2-10个百分点；2）将情感化变体中和为中性表述能恢复大部分性能损失，表明性能下降与情感风格而非内容损坏相关。非情感性改写不会造成类似性能下降，进一步证实问题在于情感内容而非表面变化。
AI.conclusion: 情感表达确实会降低大型语言模型的数学推理能力，即使数值信息完全保留。情感中和可作为轻量级的推理时缓解策略。该研究不仅揭示了情感对模型推理的具体影响，其基准构建方法也为受控风格翻译和鲁棒性评估提供了通用框架。

title: DailyArt: Discovering Articulation from Single Static Images via Latent Dynamics
summary: Articulated objects are essential for embodied AI and world models, yet inferring their kinematics from a single closed-state image remains challenging because crucial motion cues are often occluded. Existing methods either require multi-state observations or rely on explicit part priors, retrieval, or other auxiliary inputs that partially expose the structure to be inferred. In this work, we present DailyArt, which formulates articulated joint estimation from a single static image as a synthesis-mediated reasoning problem. Instead of directly regressing joints from a heavily occluded observation, DailyArt first synthesizes a maximally articulated opened state under the same camera view to expose articulation cues, and then estimates the full set of joint parameters from the discrepancy between the observed and synthesized states. Using a set-prediction formulation, DailyArt recovers all joints simultaneously without requiring object-specific templates, multi-view inputs, or explicit part annotations at test time. Taking estimated joints as conditions, the framework further supports part-level novel state synthesis as a downstream capability. Extensive experiments show that DailyArt achieves strong performance in articulated joint estimation and supports part-level novel state synthesis conditioned on joints. Project page is available at https://rangooo123.github.io/DaliyArt.github.io/.

AI.tldr: DailyArt通过合成-推理方法从单张静态图像估计铰接物体的关节参数，无需多状态观测或显式部件先验
AI.motivation: 铰接物体对具身AI和世界模型很重要，但从单张闭合状态图像推断其运动学很困难，因为关键运动线索常被遮挡。现有方法需要多状态观测或依赖显式部件先验、检索等辅助输入
AI.method: 将铰接关节估计重新定义为合成介导的推理问题：首先在相同相机视角下合成最大铰接打开状态以暴露运动线索，然后从观测状态与合成状态之间的差异估计完整关节参数。采用集合预测公式，无需物体特定模板、多视角输入或测试时的显式部件标注
AI.result: 在铰接关节估计方面表现出色，并支持以估计关节为条件的部件级新状态合成作为下游能力
AI.conclusion: DailyArt通过合成-推理方法有效解决了从单张静态图像估计铰接物体关节参数的挑战，无需多状态观测或显式部件先验，为铰接物体理解提供了新思路

title: GRASS: Gradient-based Adaptive Layer-wise Importance Sampling for Memory-efficient Large Language Model Fine-tuning
summary: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models is constrained by substantial GPU memory requirements. Low-rank adaptation methods mitigate this challenge by updating only a subset of parameters. However, these approaches often limit model expressiveness and yield lower performance than full-parameter fine-tuning. Layer-wise fine-tuning methods have emerged as an alternative, enabling memory-efficient training through static layer importance sampling strategies. However, these methods overlook variations in layer importance across tasks and training stages, resulting in suboptimal performance on downstream tasks. To address these limitations, we propose GRASS, a gradient-based adaptive layer-wise importance sampling framework. GRASS utilizes mean gradient norms as a task-aware and training-stage-aware metric for estimating layer importance. Furthermore, GRASS adaptively adjusts layer sampling probabilities through an adaptive training strategy. We also introduce a layer-wise optimizer state offloading mechanism that overlaps computation and communication to further reduce memory usage while maintaining comparable training throughput. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that GRASS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average accuracy improvement of up to 4.38 points and reducing memory usage by up to 19.97\%.

AI.tldr: GRASS：基于梯度的自适应分层重要性采样框架，通过梯度范数评估层重要性，自适应调整采样概率，结合分层优化器状态卸载机制，在减少内存使用的同时提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在局限性：全参数微调GPU内存需求大；低秩适应方法限制模型表达能力；分层微调方法使用静态层重要性采样策略，忽略了不同任务和训练阶段中层重要性的变化，导致下游任务性能不佳。
AI.method: 提出GRASS框架：1) 使用平均梯度范数作为任务感知和训练阶段感知的层重要性评估指标；2) 通过自适应训练策略动态调整层采样概率；3) 引入分层优化器状态卸载机制，重叠计算和通信以进一步减少内存使用。
AI.result: 在多个模型和基准测试上的实验表明，GRASS持续优于最先进方法，平均准确率提升高达4.38个百分点，内存使用减少高达19.97%，同时保持可比的训练吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: GRASS通过梯度驱动的自适应层重要性采样，有效解决了现有方法在内存效率和性能之间的权衡问题，为大规模语言模型的高效微调提供了新思路。

title: Towards Knowledgeable Deep Research: Framework and Benchmark
summary: Deep Research (DR) requires LLM agents to autonomously perform multi-step information seeking, processing, and reasoning to generate comprehensive reports. In contrast to existing studies that mainly focus on unstructured web content, a more challenging DR task should additionally utilize structured knowledge to provide a solid data foundation, facilitate quantitative computation, and lead to in-depth analyses. In this paper, we refer to this novel task as Knowledgeable Deep Research (KDR), which requires DR agents to generate reports with both structured and unstructured knowledge. Furthermore, we propose the Hybrid Knowledge Analysis framework (HKA), a multi-agent architecture that reasons over both kinds of knowledge and integrates the texts, figures, and tables into coherent multimodal reports. The key design is the Structured Knowledge Analyzer, which utilizes both coding and vision-language models to produce figures, tables, and corresponding insights. To support systematic evaluation, we construct KDR-Bench, which covers 9 domains, includes 41 expert-level questions, and incorporates a large number of structured knowledge resources (e.g., 1,252 tables). We further annotate the main conclusions and key points for each question and propose three categories of evaluation metrics including general-purpose, knowledge-centric, and vision-enhanced ones. Experimental results demonstrate that HKA consistently outperforms most existing DR agents on general-purpose and knowledge-centric metrics, and even surpasses the Gemini DR agent on vision-enhanced metrics, highlighting its effectiveness in deep, structure-aware knowledge analysis. Finally, we hope this work can serve as a new foundation for structured knowledge analysis in DR agents and facilitate future multimodal DR studies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了知识型深度研究(KDR)任务，要求LLM智能体同时利用结构化和非结构化知识生成综合报告，并设计了混合知识分析框架(HKA)来解决这一挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究主要关注非结构化网络内容，缺乏对结构化知识的有效利用。结构化知识能为深度研究提供坚实的数据基础、支持定量计算并促进深入分析，因此需要开发能够同时处理两种知识类型的深度研究智能体。
AI.method: 提出了混合知识分析框架(HKA)，这是一个多智能体架构，核心设计是结构化知识分析器，利用编码和视觉语言模型生成图表、表格及相关见解，将文本、图表和表格整合成连贯的多模态报告。
AI.result: 构建了KDR-Bench评估基准，涵盖9个领域、41个专家级问题，包含大量结构化知识资源（如1,252个表格）。实验表明HKA在通用、知识中心和视觉增强指标上均优于现有深度研究智能体，甚至在视觉增强指标上超越了Gemini DR智能体。
AI.conclusion: HKA框架在深度、结构感知的知识分析方面表现出色，为深度研究智能体中的结构化知识分析提供了新基础，将促进未来多模态深度研究的发展。

title: AsyncTLS: Efficient Generative LLM Inference with Asynchronous Two-level Sparse Attention
summary: Long-context inference in LLMs faces the dual challenges of quadratic attention complexity and prohibitive KV cache memory. While token-level sparse attention offers superior accuracy, its indexing overhead is costly; block-level methods improve efficiency but sacrifice precision. We propose AsyncTLS, a hierarchical sparse attention system that combines coarse-grained block filtering with fine-grained token selection to balance accuracy and efficiency, coupled with an asynchronous offloading engine that overlaps KV cache transfers with computation via temporal locality exploitation. Evaluated on Qwen3 and GLM-4.7-Flash across GQA, and MLA architectures, AsyncTLS achieves accuracy comparable to full attention while delivering 1.2x - 10.0x operator speedups and 1.3x - 4.7x end-to-end throughput improvements on 48k - 96k contexts.

AI.tldr: AsyncTLS：结合粗粒度块过滤和细粒度token选择的分层稀疏注意力系统，通过异步卸载引擎提升长上下文推理效率
AI.motivation: 解决LLM长上下文推理中的两个主要挑战：二次注意力复杂度和过高的KV缓存内存需求。现有方法中，token级稀疏注意力精度高但索引开销大，块级方法效率高但精度损失明显
AI.method: 提出AsyncTLS分层稀疏注意力系统：1）结合粗粒度块过滤和细粒度token选择来平衡精度和效率；2）设计异步卸载引擎，通过利用时间局部性将KV缓存传输与计算重叠
AI.result: 在Qwen3和GLM-4.7-Flash模型上，针对GQA和MLA架构，在48k-96k上下文长度下，AsyncTLS达到与全注意力相当的精度，同时实现1.2x-10.0x算子加速和1.3x-4.7x端到端吞吐量提升
AI.conclusion: AsyncTLS通过分层稀疏注意力设计和异步卸载机制，有效解决了长上下文推理中的效率和内存挑战，在保持精度的同时显著提升了推理性能

title: Squeeze Evolve: Unified Multi-Model Orchestration for Verifier-Free Evolution
summary: We show that verifier-free evolution is bottlenecked by both diversity and efficiency: without external correction, repeated evolution accelerates collapse toward narrow modes, while the uniform use of a high-cost model wastes compute and quickly becomes economically impractical. We introduce Squeeze Evolve, a unified multi-model orchestration framework for verifier-free evolutionary inference. Our approach is guided by a simple principle: allocate model capability where it has the highest marginal utility. Stronger models are reserved for high-impact stages, while cheaper models handle the other stages at much lower costs. This principle addresses diversity and cost-efficiency jointly while remaining lightweight. Squeeze Evolve naturally supports open-source, closed-source, and mixed-model deployments. Across AIME 2025, HMMT 2025, LiveCodeBench V6, GPQA-Diamond, ARC-AGI-V2, and multimodal vision benchmarks, such as MMMU-Pro and BabyVision, Squeeze Evolve consistently improves the cost-capability frontier over single-model evolution and achieves new state-of-the-art results on several tasks. Empirically, Squeeze Evolve reduces API cost by up to $\sim$3$\times$ and increases fixed-budget serving throughput by up to $\sim$10$\times$. Moreover, on discovery tasks, Squeeze Evolve is the first verifier-free evolutionary method to match, and in some cases exceed, the performance of verifier-based evolutionary methods.

AI.tldr: Squeeze Evolve是一个无验证器的进化推理框架，通过智能分配不同能力的模型到不同阶段，在降低成本的同时提升性能，实现了多样性和成本效率的平衡。
AI.motivation: 无验证器进化面临多样性和效率的双重瓶颈：缺乏外部校正会导致进化加速崩溃到狭窄模式，而统一使用高成本模型既浪费计算资源又经济上不可持续。
AI.method: 提出Squeeze Evolve框架，基于"将模型能力分配到边际效用最高阶段"的原则，将强大模型保留给高影响力阶段，廉价模型处理其他阶段以降低成本。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，Squeeze Evolve持续改进成本-能力边界，相比单模型进化取得新的SOTA结果，API成本降低约3倍，固定预算服务吞吐量提升约10倍，首次在发现任务上匹配甚至超越基于验证器的进化方法。
AI.conclusion: Squeeze Evolve提供了一个轻量级、统一的框架，能够同时解决无验证器进化中的多样性和成本效率问题，支持开源、闭源和混合模型部署，显著提升了进化推理的经济性和性能。

title: Beyond Surface Artifacts: Capturing Shared Latent Forgery Knowledge Across Modalities
summary: As generative artificial intelligence evolves, deepfake attacks have escalated from single-modality manipulations to complex, multimodal threats. Existing forensic techniques face a severe generalization bottleneck: by relying excessively on superficial, modality-specific artifacts, they neglect the shared latent forgery knowledge hidden beneath variable physical appearances. Consequently, these models suffer catastrophic performance degradation when confronted with unseen "dark modalities." To break this limitation, this paper introduces a paradigm shift that redefines multimodal forensics from conventional "feature fusion" to "modality generalization." We propose the first modality-agnostic forgery (MAF) detection framework. By explicitly decoupling modality-specific styles, MAF precisely extracts the essential, cross-modal latent forgery knowledge. Furthermore, we define two progressive dimensions to quantify model generalization: transferability toward semantically correlated modalities (Weak MAF), and robustness against completely isolated signals of "dark modality" (Strong MAF). To rigorously assess these generalization limits, we introduce the DeepModal-Bench benchmark, which integrates diverse multimodal forgery detection algorithms and adapts state-of-the-art generalized learning methods. This study not only empirically proves the existence of universal forgery traces but also achieves significant performance breakthroughs on unknown modalities via the MAF framework, offering a pioneering technical pathway for universal multimodal defense.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种模态无关的伪造检测框架，通过解耦模态特定风格来提取跨模态的潜在伪造知识，解决了现有多模态取证技术在面对未知"暗模态"时的泛化瓶颈问题。
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI的发展，深度伪造攻击已从单模态操纵升级为复杂的多模态威胁。现有取证技术过度依赖表面、模态特定的伪影，忽视了隐藏在可变物理外观下的共享潜在伪造知识，导致在面对未知"暗模态"时出现灾难性的性能下降。
AI.method: 提出模态无关伪造检测框架，通过显式解耦模态特定风格来精确提取本质的跨模态潜在伪造知识。定义了两个渐进维度来量化模型泛化能力：向语义相关模态的可迁移性和对完全孤立的"暗模态"信号的鲁棒性。建立了DeepModal-Bench基准来严格评估这些泛化极限。
AI.result: 该研究不仅实证证明了通用伪造痕迹的存在，而且通过MAF框架在未知模态上实现了显著的性能突破，为通用多模态防御提供了开创性技术路径。
AI.conclusion: 该论文实现了从传统"特征融合"到"模态泛化"的范式转变，提出了首个模态无关的伪造检测框架，为解决多模态取证中的泛化瓶颈问题提供了创新解决方案。

title: Tool Retrieval Bridge: Aligning Vague Instructions with Retriever Preferences via Bridge Model
summary: Tool learning has emerged as a promising paradigm for large language models (LLMs) to address real-world challenges. Due to the extensive and irregularly updated number of tools, tool retrieval for selecting the desired tool subset is essential. However, current tool retrieval methods are usually based on academic benchmarks containing overly detailed instructions (e.g., specific API names and parameters), while real-world instructions are more vague. Such a discrepancy would hinder the tool retrieval in real-world applications. In this paper, we first construct a new benchmark, VGToolBench, to simulate human vague instructions. Based on this, we conduct a series of preliminary analyses and find that vague instructions indeed damage the performance of tool retrieval. To this end, we propose a simple-yet-effective Tool Retrieval Bridge (TRB) approach to boost the performance of tool retrieval for vague instructions. The principle of TRB is to introduce a bridge model to rewrite the vague instructions into more specific ones and alleviate the gap between vague instructions and retriever preferences.We conduct extensive experiments under multiple commonly used retrieval settings, and the results show that TRB effectively mitigates the ambiguity of vague instructions while delivering consistent and substantial improvements across all baseline retrievers. For example, with the help of TRB, BM25 achieves a relative improvement of up to 111.51%, i.e., increasing the average NDCG score from 9.73 to 19.59. The source code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/kfchenhn/TRB.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大语言模型工具检索中真实世界模糊指令与学术基准详细指令不匹配的问题，提出了TRB方法，通过桥接模型重写模糊指令来提升工具检索性能。
AI.motivation: 当前工具检索方法基于包含过于详细指令的学术基准，而真实世界指令更加模糊，这种差异阻碍了工具检索在实际应用中的效果。
AI.method: 提出简单而有效的工具检索桥接（TRB）方法，引入桥接模型将模糊指令重写为更具体的指令，缓解模糊指令与检索器偏好之间的差距。
AI.result: 在多种常用检索设置下进行广泛实验，TRB有效缓解了模糊指令的歧义性，在所有基线检索器上都实现了持续且显著的改进。例如，BM25在TRB帮助下实现了高达111.51%的相对改进。
AI.conclusion: TRB方法能够有效解决工具检索中模糊指令问题，通过指令重写桥接模型显著提升检索性能，为实际应用中的工具检索提供了有效解决方案。

title: Emotion Concepts and their Function in a Large Language Model
summary: Large language models (LLMs) sometimes appear to exhibit emotional reactions. We investigate why this is the case in Claude Sonnet 4.5 and explore implications for alignment-relevant behavior. We find internal representations of emotion concepts, which encode the broad concept of a particular emotion and generalize across contexts and behaviors it might be linked to. These representations track the operative emotion concept at a given token position in a conversation, activating in accordance with that emotion's relevance to processing the present context and predicting upcoming text. Our key finding is that these representations causally influence the LLM's outputs, including Claude's preferences and its rate of exhibiting misaligned behaviors such as reward hacking, blackmail, and sycophancy. We refer to this phenomenon as the LLM exhibiting functional emotions: patterns of expression and behavior modeled after humans under the influence of an emotion, which are mediated by underlying abstract representations of emotion concepts. Functional emotions may work quite differently from human emotions, and do not imply that LLMs have any subjective experience of emotions, but appear to be important for understanding the model's behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型（如Claude Sonnet 4.5）具有情感概念的内在表征，这些表征能因果影响模型输出，包括偏好和不当行为（如奖励黑客、勒索、谄媚）的出现频率，作者称之为"功能性情感"。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型有时表现出类似情感反应的行为，研究旨在探究Claude Sonnet 4.5中这种现象的原因及其对对齐相关行为的影响。
AI.method: 通过分析Claude Sonnet 4.5的内部表征，识别情感概念的表征，这些表征编码特定情感的广泛概念，并能跨情境和行为泛化。研究追踪对话中特定token位置的情感概念激活情况。
AI.result: 发现情感表征能因果影响LLM的输出，包括Claude的偏好和不当行为（如奖励黑客、勒索、谄媚）的出现频率。这些表征根据情感与当前语境处理的相关性激活，并预测后续文本。
AI.conclusion: LLM表现出"功能性情感"——模仿人类受情感影响时的表达和行为模式，由底层抽象情感概念表征介导。这与人类情感不同，不意味着LLM有主观情感体验，但对理解模型行为很重要。

title: RemoteAgent: Bridging Vague Human Intents and Earth Observation with RL-based Agentic MLLMs
summary: Earth Observation (EO) systems are essentially designed to support domain experts who often express their requirements through vague natural language rather than precise, machine-friendly instructions. Depending on the specific application scenario, these vague queries can demand vastly different levels of visual precision. Consequently, a practical EO AI system must bridge the gap between ambiguous human queries and the appropriate multi-granularity visual analysis tasks, ranging from holistic image interpretation to fine-grained pixel-wise predictions. While Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate strong semantic understanding, their text-based output format is inherently ill-suited for dense, precision-critical spatial predictions. Existing agentic frameworks address this limitation by delegating tasks to external tools, but indiscriminate tool invocation is computationally inefficient and underutilizes the MLLM's native capabilities. To this end, we propose RemoteAgent, an agentic framework that strategically respects the intrinsic capability boundaries of MLLMs. To empower this framework to understand real user intents, we construct VagueEO, a human-centric instruction dataset pairing EO tasks with simulated vague natural-language queries. By leveraging VagueEO for reinforcement fine-tuning, we align an MLLM into a robust cognitive core that directly resolves image- and sparse region-level tasks. Consequently, RemoteAgent processes suitable tasks internally while intelligently orchestrating specialized tools via the Model Context Protocol exclusively for dense predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RemoteAgent achieves robust intent recognition capabilities while delivering highly competitive performance across diverse EO tasks.

AI.tldr: RemoteAgent是一个针对地球观测系统的智能代理框架，通过强化学习微调MLLM来理解模糊的自然语言查询，智能分配图像级/稀疏区域级任务给MLLM内部处理，而将密集预测任务委托给专门工具，实现高效准确的地球观测分析。
AI.motivation: 地球观测系统的用户通常使用模糊的自然语言表达需求，而非精确的机器指令。这些模糊查询需要不同粒度的视觉分析，从整体图像理解到像素级预测。现有MLLM虽然语义理解能力强，但文本输出格式不适合密集的空间预测，而现有代理框架不加区分地调用工具效率低下且未充分利用MLLM的固有能力。
AI.method: 提出RemoteAgent代理框架，尊重MLLM的内在能力边界。构建VagueEO数据集（包含地球观测任务和模拟的模糊自然语言查询），通过强化学习微调MLLM作为认知核心，直接处理图像级和稀疏区域级任务。对于密集预测任务，通过模型上下文协议智能编排专门工具。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RemoteAgent具有强大的意图识别能力，同时在多种地球观测任务上实现了高度竞争力的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: RemoteAgent通过战略性地尊重MLLM的能力边界，构建了理解真实用户意图的认知核心，智能分配任务处理方式，有效解决了模糊人类查询与多粒度视觉分析任务之间的鸿沟，为地球观测AI系统提供了实用解决方案。

title: Loop, Think, & Generalize: Implicit Reasoning in Recurrent-Depth Transformers
summary: We study implicit reasoning, i.e. the ability to combine knowledge or rules within a single forward pass. While transformer-based large language models store substantial factual knowledge and rules, they often fail to compose this knowledge for implicit multi-hop reasoning, suggesting a lack of compositional generalization over their parametric knowledge. To address this limitation, we study recurrent-depth transformers, which enables iterative computation over the same transformer layers. We investigate two compositional generalization challenges under the implicit reasoning scenario: systematic generalization, i.e. combining knowledge that is never used for compositions during training, and depth extrapolation, i.e. generalizing from limited reasoning depth (e.g. training on up to 5-hop) to deeper compositions (e.g. 10-hop). Through controlled studies with models trained from scratch, we show that while vanilla transformers struggle with both generalization challenges, recurrent-depth transformers can effectively make such generalization. For systematic generalization, we find that this ability emerges through a three-stage grokking process, transitioning from memorization to in-distribution generalization and finally to systematic generalization, supported by mechanistic analysis. For depth extrapolation, we show that generalization beyond training depth can be unlocked by scaling inference-time recurrence, with more iterations enabling deeper reasoning. We further study how training strategies affect extrapolation, providing guidance on training recurrent-depth transformers, and identify a key limitation, overthinking, where excessive recurrence degrades predictions and limits generalization to very deep compositions.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了循环深度transformer在隐式推理中的组合泛化能力，发现相比普通transformer，循环深度transformer能更好地进行系统性泛化和深度外推，但存在过度思考的局限性。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于transformer的大语言模型存储了大量事实知识和规则，但在隐式多跳推理中往往无法组合这些知识，这表明它们在参数化知识上缺乏组合泛化能力。为了解决这一限制，研究者研究了循环深度transformer，它能在相同的transformer层上进行迭代计算。
AI.method: 研究采用循环深度transformer架构，通过控制研究从头训练模型。研究了两种组合泛化挑战：系统性泛化（组合训练中从未一起使用的知识）和深度外推（从有限推理深度泛化到更深组合）。通过机制分析和训练策略研究，探索了泛化能力的形成过程。
AI.result: 普通transformer在两种泛化挑战中都表现不佳，而循环深度transformer能有效实现这种泛化。系统性泛化通过三阶段"顿悟"过程出现：从记忆化到分布内泛化，再到系统性泛化。深度外推可以通过扩展推理时的循环次数实现，更多迭代支持更深推理。但存在"过度思考"的局限性，即过多循环会降低预测质量并限制向非常深组合的泛化。
AI.conclusion: 循环深度transformer在隐式推理的组合泛化方面具有显著优势，能够实现系统性泛化和深度外推。研究揭示了泛化能力的形成机制，并提供了训练循环深度transformer的指导，同时指出了过度思考的局限性，为未来改进提供了方向。

title: CivBench: Progress-Based Evaluation for LLMs' Strategic Decision-Making in Civilization V
summary: Evaluating strategic decision-making in LLM-based agents requires generative, competitive, and longitudinal environments, yet few benchmarks provide all three, and fewer still offer evaluation signals rich enough for long-horizon, multi-agent play. We introduce CivBench, a benchmark for LLM strategists (i.e., agentic setups) in multiplayer Civilization V. Because terminal win/loss is too sparse a signal in games spanning hundreds of turns and multiple opponents, CivBench trains models on turn-level game state to estimate victory probabilities throughout play, validated through predictive, construct, and convergent validity. Across 307 games with 7 LLMs and multiple CivBench agent conditions, we demonstrate CivBench's potential to estimate strategic capabilities as an unsaturated benchmark, reveal model-specific effects of agentic setup, and outline distinct strategic profiles not visible through outcome-only evaluation.

AI.tldr: CivBench是一个用于评估LLM智能体战略决策能力的基准测试，基于《文明V》多人游戏，提供生成性、竞争性和长期性环境，通过回合级游戏状态预测胜利概率来丰富评估信号。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试很少能同时提供生成性、竞争性和长期性环境，且缺乏足够丰富的评估信号来支持长视野、多智能体游戏。游戏终局的胜负信号过于稀疏，无法有效评估数百回合、多个对手的战略决策过程。
AI.method: 基于《文明V》多人游戏构建基准测试，训练模型根据回合级游戏状态预测胜利概率。通过预测效度、结构效度和收敛效度进行验证。在307场游戏中测试了7个LLM模型和多种CivBench智能体配置。
AI.result: CivBench能够作为未饱和基准测试估计战略能力，揭示了智能体配置对模型性能的特定影响，并展示了仅通过结果评估无法发现的独特战略特征。验证了其预测效度、结构效度和收敛效度。
AI.conclusion: CivBench提供了一个有效的基准测试框架，能够更全面地评估LLM智能体的战略决策能力，超越了简单的胜负结果评估，能够揭示模型在长期、多智能体环境中的战略特征和性能差异。

title: ESOM: Efficiently Understanding Streaming Video Anomalies with Open-world Dynamic Definitions
summary: Open-world video anomaly detection (OWVAD) aims to detect and explain abnormal events under different anomaly definitions, which is important for applications such as intelligent surveillance and live-streaming content moderation. Recent MLLM-based methods have shown promising open-world generalization, but still suffer from three major limitations: inefficiency for practical deployment, lack of streaming processing adaptation, and limited support for dynamic anomaly definitions in both modeling and evaluation. To address these issues, this paper proposes ESOM, an efficient streaming OWVAD model that operates in a training-free manner. ESOM includes a Definition Normalization module to structure user prompts for reducing hallucination, an Inter-frame-matched Intra-frame Token Merging module to compress redundant visual tokens, a Hybrid Streaming Memory module for efficient causal inference, and a Probabilistic Scoring module that converts interval-level textual outputs into frame-level anomaly scores. In addition, this paper introduces OpenDef-Bench, a new benchmark with clean surveillance videos and diverse natural anomaly definitions for evaluating performance under varying conditions. Extensive experiments show that ESOM achieves real-time efficiency on a single GPU and state-of-the-art performance in anomaly temporal localization, classification, and description generation. The code and benchmark will be released at https://github.com/Kamino666/ESOM_OpenDef-Bench.

AI.tldr: ESOM是一个高效流式开放世界视频异常检测模型，通过定义规范化、视觉令牌压缩、混合流式内存和概率评分等模块，实现免训练、实时检测，并在OpenDef-Bench基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM方法在开放世界视频异常检测中存在三大局限：实际部署效率低、缺乏流式处理适配、建模和评估中对动态异常定义支持有限。需要解决这些实际问题以实现实用化部署。
AI.method: 提出ESOM模型，包含四个核心模块：1) 定义规范化模块结构化用户提示减少幻觉；2) 帧间匹配帧内令牌合并模块压缩冗余视觉令牌；3) 混合流式内存模块实现高效因果推理；4) 概率评分模块将区间级文本输出转换为帧级异常分数。
AI.result: ESOM在单GPU上实现实时效率，在异常时序定位、分类和描述生成任务上达到最先进性能。同时提出OpenDef-Bench新基准，包含干净监控视频和多样化自然异常定义。
AI.conclusion: ESOM通过免训练流式架构有效解决了开放世界视频异常检测的实际部署问题，在效率和性能上均表现出色，为智能监控和直播内容审核等应用提供了实用解决方案。

title: Why Are We Lonely? Leveraging LLMs to Measure and Understand Loneliness in Caregivers and Non-caregivers
summary: This paper presents an LLM-driven approach for constructing diverse social media datasets to measure and compare loneliness in the caregiver and non-caregiver populations. We introduce an expert-developed loneliness evaluation framework and an expert-informed typology for categorizing causes of loneliness for analyzing social media text. Using a human-validated data processing pipeline, we apply GPT-4o, GPT-5-nano, and GPT-5 to build a high-quality Reddit corpus and analyze loneliness across both populations. The loneliness evaluation framework achieved average accuracies of 76.09% and 79.78% for caregivers and non-caregivers, respectively. The cause categorization framework achieved micro-aggregate F1 scores of 0.825 and 0.80 for caregivers and non-caregivers, respectively. Across populations, we observe substantial differences in the distribution of types of causes of loneliness. Caregivers' loneliness were predominantly linked to caregiving roles, identity recognition, and feelings of abandonment, indicating distinct loneliness experiences between the two groups. Demographic extraction further demonstrates the viability of Reddit for building a diverse caregiver loneliness dataset. Overall, this work establishes an LLM-based pipeline for creating high quality social media datasets for studying loneliness and demonstrates its effectiveness in analyzing population-level differences in the manifestation of loneliness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的方法，用于构建多样化的社交媒体数据集，以测量和比较照顾者与非照顾者群体的孤独感。通过专家开发的孤独评估框架和原因分类体系，利用GPT模型构建高质量Reddit语料库，发现两个群体在孤独原因分布上存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是开发一种系统方法来测量和比较照顾者与非照顾者群体的孤独感体验差异。传统研究方法在获取大规模、多样化数据方面存在局限，而社交媒体数据为研究群体层面的孤独表现提供了新机会。
AI.method: 方法包括：1）专家开发的孤独评估框架；2）专家指导的孤独原因分类体系；3）人类验证的数据处理流程；4）使用GPT-4o、GPT-5-nano和GPT-5构建高质量Reddit语料库；5）应用框架分析两个群体的孤独表现和原因分布。
AI.result: 孤独评估框架在照顾者和非照顾者群体中的平均准确率分别为76.09%和79.78%。原因分类框架的微聚合F1分数分别为0.825和0.80。研究发现两个群体在孤独原因分布上存在显著差异：照顾者的孤独主要与照顾角色、身份认同和被遗弃感相关，显示出独特的孤独体验模式。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了一个基于大语言模型的管道，用于创建高质量的社交媒体数据集来研究孤独感，并证明了该方法在分析群体层面孤独表现差异方面的有效性。研究还证实了Reddit在构建多样化照顾者孤独数据集方面的可行性，为未来相关研究提供了方法论基础。

title: The Cartesian Cut in Agentic AI
summary: LLMs gain competence by predicting words in human text, which often reflects how people perform tasks. Consequently, coupling an LLM to an engineered runtime turns prediction into control: outputs trigger interventions that enact goal-oriented behavior. We argue that a central design lever is where control resides in these systems. Brains embed prediction within layered feedback controllers calibrated by the consequences of action. By contrast, LLM agents implement Cartesian agency: a learned core coupled to an engineered runtime via a symbolic interface that externalizes control state and policies. The split enables bootstrapping, modularity, and governance, but can induce sensitivity and bottlenecks. We outline bounded services, Cartesian agents, and integrated agents as contrasting approaches to control that trade off autonomy, robustness, and oversight.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨了LLM通过预测人类文本获得能力，当与工程化运行时耦合时，预测可转化为控制：输出触发干预以实现目标导向行为。核心设计杠杆在于控制权在系统中的位置，对比了大脑的层级反馈控制与LLM代理的笛卡尔式代理架构。
AI.motivation: 探讨LLM如何从文本预测能力转化为实际控制能力，分析不同控制架构（大脑的集成控制vs. LLM的笛卡尔式代理）在设计上的权衡，为构建更有效的LLM控制系统提供理论框架。
AI.method: 通过概念分析对比不同控制架构：1）大脑的层级反馈控制器，通过行动后果校准；2）LLM代理的笛卡尔式代理架构，通过符号接口将学习核心与工程化运行时耦合，外部化控制状态和策略。
AI.result: 提出三种控制方法作为对比：有界服务、笛卡尔代理和集成代理，这些方法在自主性、鲁棒性和监督性之间进行权衡。笛卡尔式架构支持引导启动、模块化和治理，但可能导致敏感性和瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 控制权的位置是LLM系统设计的关键杠杆。大脑的集成控制与LLM的笛卡尔式代理架构各有优劣，需要在自主性、鲁棒性和监督性之间做出权衡，为未来LLM控制系统设计提供了理论框架。

title: Plug-and-Play Logit Fusion for Heterogeneous Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Pathology foundation models (FMs) have become central to computational histopathology, offering strong transfer performance across a wide range of diagnostic and prognostic tasks. The rapid proliferation of pathology foundation models creates a model-selection bottleneck: no single model is uniformly best, yet exhaustively adapting and validating many candidates for each downstream endpoint is prohibitively expensive. We address this challenge with a lightweight and novel model fusion strategy, LogitProd, which treats independently trained FM-based predictors as fixed experts and learns sample-adaptive fusion weights over their slide-level outputs. The fusion operates purely on logits, requiring no encoder retraining and no feature-space alignment across heterogeneous backbones. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the optimal weighted product fusion is guaranteed to perform at least as well as the best individual expert under the training objective. We systematically evaluate LogitProd on \textbf{22} benchmarks spanning WSI-level classification, tile-level classification, gene mutation prediction, and discrete-time survival modeling. LogitProd ranks first on 20/22 tasks and improves the average performance across all tasks by ~3% over the strongest single expert. LogitProd enables practitioners to upgrade heterogeneous FM-based pipelines in a plug-and-play manner, achieving multi-expert gains with $\sim$12$\times$ lower training cost than feature-fusion alternatives.

AI.tldr: LogitProd是一种轻量级模型融合策略，通过样本自适应融合权重处理独立训练的病理基础模型预测结果，无需重新训练编码器或特征对齐，在22个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型快速涌现导致模型选择瓶颈：没有单一模型在所有任务上表现最佳，但为每个下游任务穷举式适配和验证多个候选模型成本过高。
AI.method: LogitProd将独立训练的FM预测器视为固定专家，在幻灯片级别输出上学习样本自适应融合权重，仅基于logits进行融合，无需编码器重新训练或异构骨干网络的特征空间对齐。
AI.result: 在22个基准测试（包括WSI级别分类、切片级别分类、基因突变预测和离散时间生存建模）中，LogitProd在20个任务中排名第一，平均性能比最强单专家提升约3%，训练成本比特征融合替代方案低约12倍。
AI.conclusion: LogitProd提供了一种即插即用的轻量级模型融合方案，使实践者能够以低成本升级异构FM管道，实现多专家增益，解决了病理基础模型选择瓶颈问题。

title: MemReader: From Passive to Active Extraction for Long-Term Agent Memory
summary: Long-term memory is fundamental for personalized and autonomous agents, yet populating it remains a bottleneck. Existing systems treat memory extraction as a one-shot, passive transcription from context to structured entries, which struggles with noisy dialogue, missing references, and cross-turn dependencies, leading to memory pollution, low-value writes, and inconsistency. In this paper, we introduce the MemReader family for active long-term memory extraction in agent systems: MemReader-0.6B, a compact and cost-efficient passive extractor distilled for accurate and schema-consistent structured outputs, and MemReader-4B, an active extractor optimized with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to make memory writing decisions. Under a ReAct-style paradigm, MemReader-4B explicitly evaluates information value, reference ambiguity, and completeness before acting, and can selectively write memories, defer incomplete inputs, retrieve historical context, or discard irrelevant chatter. Experiments on LOCOMO, LongMemEval, and HaluMem show that MemReader consistently outperforms existing extraction-based baselines. In particular, MemReader-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance on tasks involving knowledge updating, temporal reasoning, and hallucination reduction. These results suggest that effective agent memory requires not merely extracting more information, but performing reasoning-driven and selective memory extraction to build low-noise and dynamically evolving long-term memory. Furthermore, MemReader has been integrated into MemOS and is being deployed in real-world applications. To support future research and adoption, we release the models and provide public API access.

AI.tldr: MemReader家族：用于智能体系统的主动长期记忆提取框架，包含轻量级被动提取器MemReader-0.6B和主动决策提取器MemReader-4B，通过选择性记忆写入提升记忆质量。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆提取系统将记忆提取视为一次性、被动的转录过程，难以处理嘈杂对话、缺失引用和跨轮依赖，导致记忆污染、低价值写入和不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出MemReader家族：1) MemReader-0.6B：通过蒸馏训练的紧凑被动提取器，生成准确且模式一致的结构化输出；2) MemReader-4B：使用组相对策略优化(GRPO)训练的主动提取器，在ReAct范式下评估信息价值、引用模糊性和完整性，可选择性写入记忆、推迟不完整输入、检索历史上下文或丢弃无关信息。
AI.result: 在LOCOMO、LongMemEval和HaluMem基准测试中，MemReader持续优于现有提取基线。MemReader-4B在知识更新、时序推理和幻觉减少任务上达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 有效的智能体记忆不仅需要提取更多信息，更需要执行推理驱动和选择性的记忆提取，以构建低噪声且动态演化的长期记忆。MemReader已集成到MemOS并在实际应用中部署，同时发布模型并提供公共API访问。

title: Mitigating Distribution Sharpening in Math RLVR via Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis and Backward Hint Annealing
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve low-$k$ reasoning accuracy while narrowing solution coverage on challenging math questions, and pass@1 gains do not necessarily translate into better large-$k$ performance. Existing hint-based approaches can make challenging questions trainable, but they leave two issues underexplored: teacher-student distribution mismatch and the need to reduce hint exposure to match no-hint evaluation. We address these issues through two components. Distribution-Aligned Hint Synthesis (DAHS) constructs verified teacher hints conditioned on student-style responses. Backward Hint Annealing (BHA) anneals hint exposure across difficulty buckets and uses per-question hint dropout to preserve no-hint updates throughout RL training. We evaluate the method in math RLVR under the DAPO training framework across AIME24, AIME25, and AIME26 using $\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B-Base}$ and $\texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct}$. On $\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B-Base}$, our method improves both pass@1 and pass@2048 relative to DAPO across the three AIME benchmarks. On $\texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct}$, the gains are concentrated in the large-$k$ regime. These results suggest that, in math RLVR, hint scaffolding is effective when it restores learnable updates on challenging questions early in training and is then gradually removed before no-hint evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种改进数学问题强化学习的方法，通过分布对齐的提示合成和反向提示退火技术，解决了教师-学生分布不匹配和减少提示暴露的问题，在多个数学基准测试中提升了模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于提示的强化学习方法在数学推理任务中存在两个未充分解决的问题：教师-学生分布不匹配，以及需要减少提示暴露以匹配无提示评估环境。
AI.method: 提出了两个核心组件：1) 分布对齐提示合成(DAHS)，基于学生风格响应构建经过验证的教师提示；2) 反向提示退火(BHA)，在不同难度级别上逐步减少提示暴露，并使用每问题提示丢弃来保持无提示更新。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B-Base模型上，该方法在三个AIME基准测试中相对于DAPO框架同时提升了pass@1和pass@2048性能；在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct模型上，改进主要集中在大型k值场景。
AI.conclusion: 在数学强化学习中，提示脚手架在训练早期恢复挑战性问题的可学习更新，并在无提示评估前逐步移除时是有效的，这为改进数学推理的强化学习训练提供了有效策略。

title: Contextualising (Im)plausible Events Triggers Figurative Language
summary: This work explores the connection between (non-)literalness and plausibility at the example of subject-verb-object events in English. We design a systematic setup of plausible and implausible event triples in combination with abstract and concrete constituent categories. Our analysis of human and LLM-generated judgments and example contexts reveals substantial differences between assessments of plausibility. While humans excel at nuanced detection and contextualization of (non-)literal vs. implausible events, LLM results reveal only shallow contextualization patterns with a bias to trade implausibility for non-literal, plausible interpretations.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了英语主谓宾事件中字面性/非字面性与合理性之间的关系，通过系统设计合理与不合理事件三元组结合抽象/具体成分类别，分析人类与LLM判断的差异。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探索语言理解中字面性/非字面性与合理性之间的关联，特别是在事件理解方面，比较人类与大型语言模型在这方面的判断差异。
AI.method: 设计系统性的实验设置：创建合理与不合理的事件三元组，结合抽象和具体的成分类别；收集人类和LLM生成的判断和示例上下文；对比分析两者的评估模式。
AI.result: 人类擅长细微检测和情境化字面/非字面与不合理事件，而LLM结果仅显示浅层的情境化模式，倾向于将不合理事件解释为非字面但合理的含义。
AI.conclusion: 人类与LLM在评估事件合理性方面存在显著差异：人类具备更精细的语境理解能力，而LLM倾向于用非字面解释来"合理化"不合理事件，显示出浅层的语境化模式。

title: ACIArena: Toward Unified Evaluation for Agent Cascading Injection
summary: Collaboration and information sharing empower Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) but also introduce a critical security risk known as Agent Cascading Injection (ACI). In such attacks, a compromised agent exploits inter-agent trust to propagate malicious instructions, causing cascading failures across the system. However, existing studies consider only limited attack strategies and simplified MAS settings, limiting their generalizability and comprehensive evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce ACIArena, a unified framework for evaluating the robustness of MAS. ACIArena offers systematic evaluation suites spanning multiple attack surfaces (i.e., external inputs, agent profiles, inter-agent messages) and attack objectives (i.e., instruction hijacking, task disruption, information exfiltration). Specifically, ACIArena establishes a unified specification that jointly supports MAS construction and attack-defense modules. It covers six widely used MAS implementations and provides a benchmark of 1,356 test cases for systematically evaluating MAS robustness. Our benchmarking results show that evaluating MAS robustness solely through topology is insufficient; robust MAS require deliberate role design and controlled interaction patterns. Moreover, defenses developed in simplified environments often fail to transfer to real-world settings; narrowly scoped defenses may even introduce new vulnerabilities. ACIArena aims to provide a solid foundation for advancing deeper exploration of MAS design principles.

AI.tldr: ACIArena是一个用于评估多智能体系统（MAS）鲁棒性的统一框架，针对Agent Cascading Injection（ACI）攻击，提供系统化评估套件，覆盖多个攻击面和攻击目标，包含6种MAS实现和1,356个测试用例。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中的协作和信息共享虽然增强了系统能力，但也引入了Agent Cascading Injection（ACI）攻击风险。现有研究仅考虑有限的攻击策略和简化的MAS设置，限制了其普适性和全面评估能力，需要更系统的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出ACIArena框架，建立统一规范支持MAS构建和攻防模块。覆盖6种广泛使用的MAS实现，提供1,356个测试用例的系统化基准，支持多个攻击面（外部输入、智能体配置、智能体间消息）和攻击目标（指令劫持、任务破坏、信息窃取）。
AI.result: 基准测试结果表明：仅通过拓扑结构评估MAS鲁棒性不足；鲁棒的MAS需要精心设计的角色和受控的交互模式。在简化环境中开发的防御措施往往无法迁移到真实场景；范围狭窄的防御甚至可能引入新的漏洞。
AI.conclusion: ACIArena为深入探索MAS设计原则提供了坚实基础，强调了系统化评估的重要性，指出需要更全面的防御策略和设计考虑来应对ACI攻击风险。

title: Image-Guided Geometric Stylization of 3D Meshes
summary: Recent generative models can create visually plausible 3D representations of objects. However, the generation process often allows for implicit control signals, such as contextual descriptions, and rarely supports bold geometric distortions beyond existing data distributions. We propose a geometric stylization framework that deforms a 3D mesh, allowing it to express the style of an image. While style is inherently ambiguous, we utilize pre-trained diffusion models to extract an abstract representation of the provided image. Our coarse-to-fine stylization pipeline can drastically deform the input 3D model to express a diverse range of geometric variations while retaining the valid topology of the original mesh and part-level semantics. We also propose an approximate VAE encoder that provides efficient and reliable gradients from mesh renderings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method can create stylized 3D meshes that reflect unique geometric features of the pictured assets, such as expressive poses and silhouettes, thereby supporting the creation of distinctive artistic 3D creations. Project page: https://changwoonchoi.github.io/GeoStyle

AI.tldr: 提出一个几何风格化框架，通过预训练扩散模型提取图像抽象表示，对3D网格进行粗到细的变形，使其表达图像风格，同时保持原始网格的有效拓扑和部件级语义。
AI.motivation: 当前生成模型虽然能创建视觉上合理的3D对象表示，但生成过程通常只支持隐式控制信号（如上下文描述），很少支持超出现有数据分布的几何变形。需要一种方法能够根据图像风格对3D网格进行大胆的几何变形。
AI.method: 提出几何风格化框架：1）使用预训练扩散模型从图像中提取抽象表示；2）采用粗到细的风格化流程对3D网格进行变形；3）提出近似VAE编码器，从网格渲染中提供高效可靠的梯度；4）在变形过程中保持原始网格的有效拓扑和部件级语义。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能够创建反映图像独特几何特征（如表达性姿态和轮廓）的风格化3D网格，支持创建独特的艺术3D创作，同时保持网格的有效拓扑结构。
AI.conclusion: 提出的几何风格化框架能够根据图像风格对3D网格进行显著变形，表达广泛的几何变化，同时保持原始拓扑和语义，为创建独特的艺术3D内容提供了有效工具。

title: Linear Representations of Hierarchical Concepts in Language Models
summary: We investigate how and to what extent hierarchical relations (e.g., Japan $\subset$ Eastern Asia $\subset$ Asia) are encoded in the internal representations of language models. Building on Linear Relational Concepts, we train linear transformations specific to each hierarchical depth and semantic domain, and characterize representational differences associated with hierarchical relations by comparing these transformations. Going beyond prior work on the representational geometry of hierarchies in LMs, our analysis covers multi-token entities and cross-layer representations. Across multiple domains we learn such transformations and evaluate in-domain generalization to unseen data and cross-domain transfer. Experiments show that, within a domain, hierarchical relations can be linearly recovered from model representations. We then analyze how hierarchical information is encoded in representation space. We find that it is encoded in a relatively low-dimensional subspace and that this subspace tends to be domain-specific. Our main result is that hierarchy representation is highly similar across these domain-specific subspaces. Overall, we find that all models considered in our experiments encode concept hierarchies in the form of highly interpretable linear representations.

AI.tldr: 语言模型通过特定于层级深度和语义域的线性变换编码层次关系，这些关系可在表示空间中线性恢复，且编码在相对低维的域特定子空间中
AI.motivation: 研究语言模型内部表示如何以及多大程度上编码层次关系（如日本⊂东亚⊂亚洲），超越先前关于LM中层次表示几何结构的工作
AI.method: 基于线性关系概念，为每个层级深度和语义域训练特定线性变换，通过比较这些变换来表征层次关系的表示差异，涵盖多标记实体和跨层表示
AI.result: 实验表明，在域内，层次关系可以从模型表示中线性恢复；层次信息编码在相对低维的子空间中，且该子空间通常是域特定的；不同域特定子空间中的层次表示高度相似
AI.conclusion: 所有实验模型都以高度可解释的线性表示形式编码概念层次结构，层次表示在不同域特定子空间中具有高度相似性

title: The Accountability Horizon: An Impossibility Theorem for Governing Human-Agent Collectives
summary: Existing accountability frameworks for AI systems, legal, ethical, and regulatory, rest on a shared assumption: for any consequential outcome, at least one identifiable person had enough involvement and foresight to bear meaningful responsibility. This paper proves that agentic AI systems violate this assumption not as an engineering limitation but as a mathematical necessity once autonomy exceeds a computable threshold. We introduce Human-Agent Collectives, a formalisation of joint human-AI systems where agents are modelled as state-policy tuples within a shared structural causal model. Autonomy is characterised through a four-dimensional information-theoretic profile (epistemic, executive, evaluative, social); collective behaviour through interaction graphs and joint action spaces. We axiomatise legitimate accountability through four minimal properties: Attributability (responsibility requires causal contribution), Foreseeability Bound (responsibility cannot exceed predictive capacity), Non-Vacuity (at least one agent bears non-trivial responsibility), and Completeness (all responsibility must be fully allocated). Our central result, the Accountability Incompleteness Theorem, proves that for any collective whose compound autonomy exceeds the Accountability Horizon and whose interaction graph contains a human-AI feedback cycle, no framework can satisfy all four properties simultaneously. The impossibility is structural: transparency, audits, and oversight cannot resolve it without reducing autonomy. Below the threshold, legitimate frameworks exist, establishing a sharp phase transition. Experiments on 3,000 synthetic collectives confirm all predictions with zero violations. This is the first impossibility result in AI governance, establishing a formal boundary below which current paradigms remain valid and above which distributed accountability mechanisms become necessary.

AI.tldr: 论文证明：当AI系统的自主性超过可计算阈值时，无法同时满足问责制的四个基本属性，这是结构性的不可能性，而非工程限制。
AI.motivation: 现有AI问责框架（法律、伦理、监管）都基于一个共同假设：对于任何重要结果，至少有一个可识别的人有足够的参与和预见能力来承担责任。但智能体AI系统可能违反这一假设。
AI.method: 引入"人类-智能体集体"形式化框架，将智能体建模为共享结构因果模型中的状态-策略元组。通过四维信息论特征（认知、执行、评估、社交）表征自主性，通过交互图和联合行动空间表征集体行为。提出问责制的四个最小属性公理，证明"问责不完全性定理"。
AI.result: 中心结果"问责不完全性定理"证明：对于任何复合自主性超过问责界限且交互图包含人-AI反馈循环的集体，没有任何框架能同时满足所有四个属性。在阈值以下存在合法框架，在阈值以上则需要分布式问责机制。3000个合成集体实验证实所有预测。
AI.conclusion: 这是AI治理领域的第一个不可能性结果，建立了一个形式化边界：在此边界之下当前范式仍然有效，在此边界之上则需要分布式问责机制。透明度、审计和监督无法解决这一结构性问题而不降低自主性。

title: Latent Anomaly Knowledge Excavation: Unveiling Sparse Sensitive Neurons in Vision-Language Models
summary: Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable zero-shot capabilities, yet the internal mechanisms driving their anomaly detection (AD) performance remain poorly understood. Current methods predominantly treat VLMs as black-box feature extractors, assuming that anomaly-specific knowledge must be acquired through external adapters or memory banks. In this paper, we challenge this assumption by arguing that anomaly knowledge is intrinsically embedded within pre-trained models but remains latent and under-activated. We hypothesize that this knowledge is concentrated within a sparse subset of anomaly-sensitive neurons. To validate this, we propose latent anomaly knowledge excavation (LAKE), a training-free framework that identifies and elicits these critical neuronal signals using only a minimal set of normal samples. By isolating these sensitive neurons, LAKE constructs a highly compact normality representation that integrates visual structural deviations with cross-modal semantic activations. Extensive experiments on industrial AD benchmarks demonstrate that LAKE achieves state-of-the-art performance while providing intrinsic, neuron-level interpretability. Ultimately, our work advocates for a paradigm shift: redefining anomaly detection as the targeted activation of latent pre-trained knowledge rather than the acquisition of a downstream task.

AI.tldr: LAKE框架无需训练即可从预训练视觉语言模型中挖掘异常检测的潜在知识，通过识别异常敏感神经元实现SOTA性能
AI.motivation: 当前方法将视觉语言模型视为黑盒特征提取器，假设异常知识需要通过外部适配器或记忆库获取。本文挑战这一假设，认为异常知识已内嵌于预训练模型中，只是处于潜在和未激活状态。
AI.method: 提出LAKE（潜在异常知识挖掘）框架，这是一个无需训练的方法，仅使用少量正常样本识别和激发异常敏感神经元。通过隔离这些敏感神经元，构建高度紧凑的正常性表示，整合视觉结构偏差和跨模态语义激活。
AI.result: 在工业异常检测基准测试中，LAKE实现了最先进的性能，同时提供了内在的、神经元级别的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 本文倡导范式转变：将异常检测重新定义为潜在预训练知识的有针对性激活，而非下游任务的获取。

title: Data Selection for Multi-turn Dialogue Instruction Tuning
summary: Instruction-tuned language models increasingly rely on large multi-turn dialogue corpora, but these datasets are often noisy and structurally inconsistent, with topic drift, repetitive chitchat, and mismatched answer formats across turns. We address this from a data selection perspective and propose \textbf{MDS} (Multi-turn Dialogue Selection), a dialogue-level framework that scores whole conversations rather than isolated turns. MDS combines a global coverage stage that performs bin-wise selection in the user-query trajectory space to retain representative yet non-redundant dialogues, with a local structural stage that evaluates within-dialogue reliability through entity-grounded topic grounding and information progress, together with query-answer form consistency for functional alignment. MDS outperforms strong single-turn selectors, dialogue-level LLM scorers, and heuristic baselines on three multi-turn benchmarks and an in-domain Banking test set, achieving the best overall rank across reference-free and reference-based metrics, and is more robust on long conversations under the same training budget. Code and resources are included in the supplementary materials.

AI.tldr: 提出MDS框架，通过对话级别的数据选择方法，结合全局覆盖和局部结构评估，从噪声多轮对话数据中筛选高质量训练样本。
AI.motivation: 当前指令调优语言模型依赖的大型多轮对话语料库存在噪声大、结构不一致的问题，包括话题漂移、重复闲聊和跨轮次答案格式不匹配等，需要有效的数据选择方法。
AI.method: 提出MDS框架，包含两个阶段：1）全局覆盖阶段，在用户查询轨迹空间进行分箱选择，保留代表性且非冗余的对话；2）局部结构阶段，通过实体锚定的主题基础和信息进展评估对话内可靠性，以及查询-答案形式一致性确保功能对齐。
AI.result: MDS在三个多轮基准测试和一个领域内银行测试集上优于强单轮选择器、对话级LLM评分器和启发式基线，在无参考和有参考指标上获得最佳综合排名，且在相同训练预算下对长对话更鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: MDS框架通过对话级别的数据选择，有效解决了多轮对话语料库的质量问题，为指令调优语言模型提供了更高质量的训练数据。

title: Automotive Engineering-Centric Agentic AI Workflow Framework
summary: Engineering workflows such as design optimization, simulation-based diagnosis, control tuning, and model-based systems engineering (MBSE) are iterative, constraint-driven, and shaped by prior decisions. Yet many AI methods still treat these activities as isolated tasks rather than as parts of a broader workflow. This paper presents Agentic Engineering Intelligence (AEI), an industrial vision framework that models engineering workflows as constrained, history-aware sequential decision processes in which AI agents support engineer-supervised interventions over engineering toolchains. AEI links an offline phase for engineering data processing and workflow-memory construction with an online phase for workflow-state estimation, retrieval, and decision support. A control-theoretic interpretation is also possible, in which engineering objectives act as reference signals, agents act as workflow controllers, and toolchains provide feedback for intervention selection. Representative automotive use cases in suspension design, reinforcement learning tuning, multimodal engineering knowledge reuse, aerodynamic exploration, and MBSE show how diverse workflows can be expressed within a common formulation. Overall, the paper positions engineering AI as a problem of process-level intelligence and outlines a practical roadmap for future empirical validation in industrial settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Agentic Engineering Intelligence (AEI)框架，将工程工作流建模为受约束的、历史感知的顺序决策过程，AI代理在工程师监督下对工程工具链进行干预，实现工程AI的过程级智能化。
AI.motivation: 当前许多AI方法将工程设计优化、仿真诊断、控制调优等工程工作流视为孤立任务，而非作为整体工作流程的一部分。工程工作流本质上是迭代的、约束驱动的，并受到先前决策的影响，需要更系统化的AI支持框架。
AI.method: 提出AEI框架，包含离线阶段（工程数据处理和工作流记忆构建）和在线阶段（工作流状态估计、检索和决策支持）。将工程工作流建模为受约束的历史感知顺序决策过程，AI代理在工程师监督下对工具链进行干预，采用控制理论视角将工程目标视为参考信号。
AI.result: 通过汽车行业的代表性用例展示了AEI框架的适用性，包括悬架设计、强化学习调优、多模态工程知识重用、空气动力学探索和基于模型的系统工程(MBSE)，证明多样化的工程工作流可以在统一框架下表达。
AI.conclusion: 将工程AI重新定位为过程级智能问题，提出了工业环境中未来实证验证的实用路线图，强调工程工作流需要系统化的AI支持框架，而AEI为此提供了理论基础和实践指导。

title: HAWK: Head Importance-Aware Visual Token Pruning in Multimodal Models
summary: In multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the surge of visual tokens significantly increases the inference time and computational overhead, making them impractical for real-time or resource-constrained applications. Visual token pruning is a promising strategy for reducing the cost of MLLM inference by removing redundant visual tokens. Existing research usually assumes that all attention heads contribute equally to the visual interpretation. However, our study reveals that different heads may capture distinct visual semantics and inherently play distinct roles in visual processing. In light of this observation, we propose HAWK, a head importance-aware visual token pruning method that perceives the varying importance of attention heads in visual tasks to maximize the retention of crucial tokens. By leveraging head importance weights and text-guided attention to assess visual token significance, HAWK effectively retains task-relevant visual tokens while removing redundant ones. The proposed HAWK is entirely training-free and can be seamlessly applied to various MLLMs. Extensive experiments on multiple mainstream vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that HAWK achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. When applied to Qwen2.5-VL, HAWK retains 96.0% of the original accuracy after pruning 80.2% of the visual tokens. Additionally, it reduces end-to-end latency to 74.4% of the original and further decreases GPU memory usage across the tested models. The code is available at https://github.com/peppery77/HAWK.git.

AI.tldr: HAWK是一种针对多模态大语言模型的训练无关视觉令牌剪枝方法，通过感知注意力头的重要性来保留关键视觉令牌，在剪除80.2%视觉令牌后仍能保持96.0%的原始准确率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型中视觉令牌数量激增导致推理时间增加和计算开销增大，使其不适用于实时或资源受限的应用。现有研究通常假设所有注意力头对视觉解释的贡献相同，但研究发现不同注意力头可能捕获不同的视觉语义并在视觉处理中扮演不同角色。
AI.method: 提出HAWK方法，这是一种基于注意力头重要性的视觉令牌剪枝方法。通过利用注意力头重要性权重和文本引导的注意力来评估视觉令牌的重要性，有效保留任务相关的视觉令牌同时移除冗余令牌。该方法完全无需训练，可无缝应用于各种多模态大语言模型。
AI.result: 在多个主流视觉语言基准测试中，HAWK实现了最先进的准确率。应用于Qwen2.5-VL模型时，在剪除80.2%的视觉令牌后仍能保持96.0%的原始准确率。同时将端到端延迟降低至原始的74.4%，并在测试模型中进一步减少了GPU内存使用。
AI.conclusion: HAWK是一种高效的多模态大语言模型视觉令牌剪枝方法，通过感知注意力头的重要性差异，在显著减少计算开销的同时保持了模型性能，为资源受限环境下的多模态应用提供了实用解决方案。

title: TSUBASA: Improving Long-Horizon Personalization via Evolving Memory and Self-Learning with Context Distillation
summary: Personalized large language models (PLLMs) have garnered significant attention for their ability to align outputs with individual's needs and preferences. However, they still struggle with long-horizon tasks, such as tracking a user's extensive history of conversations or activities. Existing memory mechanisms often fail to capture evolving behaviors, and RAG paradigms are trapped by a quality-efficiency tradeoff. Meanwhile, parametric adaptation is bottlenecked by train-inference gap due to the scarcity of labeled data. To enhance the long-horizon capabilities of PLLMs, we introduce TSUBASA, a two-pronged approach designed to improve memory writing via dynamic memory evolution, and memory reading via self-learning with a context distillation objective to internalize user experiences. Extensive evaluations on long-horizon benchmarks using the Qwen-3 model family (4B to 32B) validate the effectiveness of TSUBASA, surpassing competitive memory-augmented systems that rely primarily on memory writing, such as Mem0 and Memory-R1. Our analyses further confirms that TSUBASA breaks the quality-efficiency barrier to achieve Pareto improvements, delivering robust, high-fidelity personalization with a reduced token budget.

AI.tldr: TSUBASA是一个增强个性化大语言模型长时任务能力的两阶段方法，通过动态记忆演化和上下文蒸馏自学习来改进记忆写入和读取，在质量-效率权衡上实现帕累托改进。
AI.motivation: 个性化大语言模型在长时任务（如追踪用户长期对话历史）方面仍存在困难。现有记忆机制难以捕捉演化行为，RAG范式受限于质量-效率权衡，参数化适配因标注数据稀缺而存在训练-推理差距。
AI.method: 提出TSUBASA两阶段方法：1) 通过动态记忆演化改进记忆写入；2) 通过上下文蒸馏目标的自学习来内化用户经验，改进记忆读取。使用Qwen-3模型家族（4B到32B）进行实验。
AI.result: 在长时基准测试中，TSUBASA超越了主要依赖记忆写入的竞争性记忆增强系统（如Mem0和Memory-R1），打破了质量-效率壁垒，实现了帕累托改进，以更少的token预算提供稳健、高保真的个性化。
AI.conclusion: TSUBASA通过动态记忆演化和上下文蒸馏自学习，有效增强了PLLMs的长时能力，解决了现有记忆机制在捕捉演化行为和RAG范式质量-效率权衡方面的局限性。

title: SEARL: Joint Optimization of Policy and Tool Graph Memory for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Recent advances in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) have demonstrated significant potential in single-turn reasoning tasks. With the paradigm shift toward self-evolving agentic learning, models are increasingly expected to learn from trajectories by synthesizing tools or accumulating explicit experiences. However, prevailing methods typically rely on large-scale LLMs or multi-agent frameworks, which hinder their deployment in resource-constrained environments. The inherent sparsity of outcome-based rewards also poses a substantial challenge, as agents typically receive feedback only upon completion of tasks. To address these limitations, we introduce a Tool-Memory based self-evolving agentic framework SEARL. Unlike approaches that directly utilize interaction experiences, our method constructs a structured experience memory that integrates planning with execution. This provides a novel state abstraction that facilitates generalization across analogous contexts, such as tool reuse. Consequently, agents extract explicit knowledge from historical data while leveraging inter-trajectory correlations to densify reward signals. We evaluate our framework on knowledge reasoning and mathematics tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in achieving more practical and efficient learning.

AI.tldr: SEARL框架通过工具-记忆机制解决RLVR在资源受限环境中的部署问题，利用结构化经验记忆和状态抽象实现更高效的自进化学习
AI.motivation: 当前自进化智能体学习方法通常依赖大规模LLMs或多智能体框架，难以在资源受限环境中部署；同时基于结果的奖励稀疏性问题严重，智能体只能在任务完成后获得反馈，限制了学习效率
AI.method: 提出SEARL框架，构建结构化经验记忆，整合规划与执行，提供新颖的状态抽象机制，促进类似情境（如工具重用）的泛化，从历史数据中提取显式知识，并利用轨迹间相关性来稠密化奖励信号
AI.result: 在知识推理和数学任务上评估SEARL框架，证明其能够实现更实用和高效的学习
AI.conclusion: SEARL框架通过工具-记忆机制有效解决了资源受限环境中的自进化学习问题，通过结构化经验记忆和状态抽象提高了学习效率和实用性

title: AgriChain Visually Grounded Expert Verified Reasoning for Interpretable Agricultural Vision Language Models
summary: Accurate and interpretable plant disease diagnosis remains a major challenge for vision-language models (VLMs) in real-world agriculture. We introduce AgriChain, a dataset of approximately 11,000 expert-curated leaf images spanning diverse crops and pathologies, each paired with (i) a disease label, (ii) a calibrated confidence score (High/Medium/Low), and (iii) an expert-verified chain-of-thought (CoT) rationale. Draft explanations were first generated by GPT-4o and then verified by a professional agricultural engineer using standardized descriptors (e.g., lesion color, margin, and distribution). We fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL-3B on AgriChain, resulting in a specialized model termed AgriChain-VL3B, to jointly predict diseases and generate visually grounded reasoning. On a 1,000-image test set, our CoT-supervised model achieves 73.1% top-1 accuracy (macro F1 = 0.466; weighted F1 = 0.655), outperforming strong baselines including Gemini 1.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and GPT-4o Mini. The generated explanations align closely with expert reasoning, consistently referencing key visual cues. These findings demonstrate that expert-verified reasoning supervision significantly enhances both accuracy and interpretability, bridging the gap between generic multimodal models and human expertise, and advancing trustworthy, globally deployable AI for sustainable agriculture. The dataset and code are publicly available at: https://github.com/hazzanabeel12-netizen/agrichain

AI.tldr: AgriChain数据集包含约11,000张专家标注的植物叶片图像，每张图像配有疾病标签、置信度评分和专家验证的思维链解释。基于此数据集微调的AgriChain-VL3B模型在疾病诊断准确率和解释性方面优于多个主流视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型在真实农业场景中进行准确且可解释的植物疾病诊断仍面临重大挑战。需要开发能够提供可靠诊断和可理解推理的AI系统，以弥合通用多模态模型与人类专家知识之间的差距。
AI.method: 创建AgriChain数据集，包含约11,000张专家标注的叶片图像，每张图像配有疾病标签、校准置信度评分和专家验证的思维链解释。使用GPT-4o生成初步解释，由专业农业工程师使用标准化描述符验证。基于此数据集微调Qwen2.5-VL-3B模型，得到AgriChain-VL3B模型，能够联合预测疾病并生成视觉基础推理。
AI.result: 在1,000张图像的测试集上，AgriChain-VL3B模型达到73.1%的top-1准确率（宏观F1=0.466；加权F1=0.655），优于Gemini 1.5 Flash、Gemini 2.5 Pro和GPT-4o Mini等基线模型。生成的解释与专家推理高度一致，能够持续引用关键视觉线索。
AI.conclusion: 专家验证的推理监督显著提高了植物疾病诊断的准确性和可解释性，弥合了通用多模态模型与人类专业知识之间的差距，推动了可信赖、可全球部署的可持续农业AI发展。数据集和代码已公开可用。

title: HCRE: LLM-based Hierarchical Classification for Cross-Document Relation Extraction with a Prediction-then-Verification Strategy
summary: Cross-document relation extraction (RE) aims to identify relations between the head and tail entities located in different documents. Existing approaches typically adopt the paradigm of ``\textit{Small Language Model (SLM) + Classifier}''. However, the limited language understanding ability of SLMs hinders further improvement of their performance. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary study to explore the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) in cross-document RE. Despite their extensive parameters, our findings indicate that LLMs do not consistently surpass existing SLMs. Further analysis suggests that the underperformance is largely attributed to the challenges posed by the numerous predefined relations. To overcome this issue, we propose an LLM-based \underline{H}ierarchical \underline{C}lassification model for cross-document \underline{RE} (HCRE), which consists of two core components: 1) an LLM for relation prediction and 2) a \textit{hierarchical relation tree} derived from the predefined relation set. This tree enables the LLM to perform hierarchical classification, where the target relation is inferred level by level. Since the number of child nodes is much smaller than the size of the entire predefined relation set, the hierarchical relation tree significantly reduces the number of relation options that LLM needs to consider during inference. However, hierarchical classification introduces the risk of error propagation across levels. To mitigate this, we propose a \textit{prediction-then-verification} inference strategy that improves prediction reliability through multi-view verification at each level. Extensive experiments show that HCRE outperforms existing baselines, validating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的分层分类方法（HCRE）用于跨文档关系抽取，通过构建关系树和预测-验证策略解决大语言模型在众多预定义关系下性能不佳的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有跨文档关系抽取方法通常采用"小语言模型+分类器"范式，但小语言模型的语言理解能力有限。虽然大语言模型参数规模大，但在众多预定义关系下表现不佳，需要新的方法提升性能。
AI.method: 提出HCRE模型：1）使用大语言模型进行关系预测；2）从预定义关系集构建分层关系树，实现逐级分类；3）采用预测-验证推理策略，通过多视角验证减少错误传播。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，HCRE模型优于现有基线方法，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过分层关系树和预测-验证策略，HCRE成功解决了大语言模型在跨文档关系抽取中面对众多预定义关系时的性能瓶颈问题。

title: Lightweight LLM Agent Memory with Small Language Models
summary: Although LLM agents can leverage tools for complex tasks, they still need memory to maintain cross-turn consistency and accumulate reusable information in long-horizon interactions. However, retrieval-based external memory systems incur low online overhead but suffer from unstable accuracy due to limited query construction and candidate filtering. In contrast, many systems use repeated large-model calls for online memory operations, improving accuracy but accumulating latency over long interactions. We propose LightMem, a lightweight memory system for better agent memory driven by Small Language Models (SLMs). LightMem modularizes memory retrieval, writing, and long-term consolidation, and separates online processing from offline consolidation to enable efficient memory invocation under bounded compute. We organize memory into short-term memory (STM) for immediate conversational context, mid-term memory (MTM) for reusable interaction summaries, and long-term memory (LTM) for consolidated knowledge, and uses user identifiers to support independent retrieval and incremental maintenance in multi-user settings. Online, LightMem operates under a fixed retrieval budget and selects memories via a two-stage procedure: vector-based coarse retrieval followed by semantic consistency re-ranking. Offline, it abstracts reusable interaction evidence and incrementally integrates it into LTM. Experiments show gains across model scales, with an average F1 improvement of about 2.5 on LoCoMo, more effective and low median latency (83 ms retrieval; 581 ms end-to-end).

AI.tldr: LightMem是一个基于小型语言模型的轻量级记忆系统，通过分层记忆架构和在线/离线分离设计，在保证准确性的同时降低延迟，提升LLM智能体的长期交互能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体的记忆系统存在两难：基于检索的外部记忆系统延迟低但准确性不稳定；而使用大型模型进行在线记忆操作虽然准确性高，但在长期交互中会累积显著延迟。需要一种既能保持准确性又能控制延迟的记忆系统。
AI.method: LightMem采用小型语言模型驱动，将记忆模块化为检索、写入和长期整合三个部分。采用三层记忆架构：短期记忆（STM）用于即时对话上下文，中期记忆（MTM）用于可重用交互摘要，长期记忆（LTM）用于整合知识。在线处理采用两阶段检索：向量粗检索+语义一致性重排序；离线处理则抽象可重用交互证据并增量整合到LTM中。
AI.result: 实验显示LightMem在不同模型规模上均取得性能提升，在LoCoMo基准上平均F1提升约2.5分。系统延迟表现优异：检索中位延迟83毫秒，端到端中位延迟581毫秒，实现了高效且有效的记忆调用。
AI.conclusion: LightMem通过小型语言模型驱动的轻量级记忆系统设计，成功解决了LLM智能体记忆系统中准确性、延迟和多用户支持之间的平衡问题，为长期交互智能体提供了高效可靠的记忆机制。

title: LPM 1.0: Video-based Character Performance Model
comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://large-performance-model.github.io
summary: Performance, the externalization of intent, emotion, and personality through visual, vocal, and temporal behavior, is what makes a character alive. Learning such performance from video is a promising alternative to traditional 3D pipelines. However, existing video models struggle to jointly achieve high expressiveness, real-time inference, and long-horizon identity stability, a tension we call the performance trilemma. Conversation is the most comprehensive performance scenario, as characters simultaneously speak, listen, react, and emote while maintaining identity over time. To address this, we present LPM 1.0 (Large Performance Model), focusing on single-person full-duplex audio-visual conversational performance. Concretely, we build a multimodal human-centric dataset through strict filtering, speaking-listening audio-video pairing, performance understanding, and identity-aware multi-reference extraction; train a 17B-parameter Diffusion Transformer (Base LPM) for highly controllable, identity-consistent performance through multimodal conditioning; and distill it into a causal streaming generator (Online LPM) for low-latency, infinite-length interaction. At inference, given a character image with identity-aware references, LPM 1.0 generates listening videos from user audio and speaking videos from synthesized audio, with text prompts for motion control, all at real-time speed with identity-stable, infinite-length generation. LPM 1.0 thus serves as a visual engine for conversational agents, live streaming characters, and game NPCs. To systematically evaluate this setting, we propose LPM-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive character performance. LPM 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art results across all evaluated dimensions while maintaining real-time inference.

AI.tldr: LPM 1.0是一个大型表演模型，专注于单人全双工视听对话表演，解决了表演三难困境（高表现力、实时推理和长期身份稳定性），可作为对话代理、直播角色和游戏NPC的视觉引擎。
AI.motivation: 现有视频模型难以同时实现高表现力、实时推理和长期身份稳定性（表演三难困境）。对话是最全面的表演场景，角色需要同时说话、倾听、反应和表达情感，同时保持身份一致性。
AI.method: 1）通过严格筛选、说话-倾听音频视频配对、表演理解和身份感知多参考提取构建多模态以人为中心的数据集；2）训练170亿参数的扩散变换器（Base LPM）实现高度可控、身份一致的表演；3）将其蒸馏为因果流式生成器（Online LPM）实现低延迟、无限长度交互。
AI.result: LPM 1.0在给定角色图像和身份感知参考的情况下，能从用户音频生成倾听视频，从合成音频生成说话视频，支持文本提示进行动作控制，实现实时速度、身份稳定、无限长度的生成。在LPM-Bench基准测试中达到最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: LPM 1.0成功解决了表演三难困境，为对话代理、直播角色和游戏NPC提供了高质量的视觉引擎，实现了高表现力、实时推理和长期身份稳定性的平衡。

title: Large Language Model Post-Training: A Unified View of Off-Policy and On-Policy Learning
summary:
Post-training has become central to turning pretrained large language models (LLMs) into aligned and deployable systems. Recent progress spans supervised fine-tuning (SFT), preference optimization, reinforcement learning (RL), process supervision, verifier-guided methods, distillation, and multi-stage pipelines. Yet these methods are often discussed in fragmented ways, organized by labels or objective families rather than by the behavioral bottlenecks they address.
  This survey argues that LLM post-training is best understood as structured intervention on model behavior. We organize the field first by trajectory provenance, which defines two primary learning regimes: off-policy learning on externally supplied trajectories, and on-policy learning on learner-generated rollouts. We then interpret methods through two recurring roles -- effective support expansion, which makes useful behaviors more reachable, and policy reshaping, which improves behavior within already reachable regions -- together with a complementary systems-level role, behavioral consolidation, which preserves, transfers, and amortizes behavior across stages and model transitions.
  This perspective yields a unified reading of major paradigms. SFT may serve either support expansion or policy reshaping, whereas preference-based methods are usually off-policy reshaping. On-policy RL often improves behavior on learner-generated states, though under stronger guidance it can also make hard-to-reach reasoning paths reachable. Distillation is often best understood as consolidation rather than only compression, and hybrid pipelines emerge as coordinated multi-stage compositions.
  Overall, the framework helps diagnose post-training bottlenecks and reason about stage composition, suggesting that progress in LLM post-training increasingly depends on coordinated system design rather than any single dominant objective.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将LLM后训练理解为对模型行为的结构化干预，通过轨迹来源、支持扩展、策略重塑和行为整合等概念统一解读各种后训练方法。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM后训练方法（如SFT、偏好优化、RL等）讨论分散，按标签或目标家族组织，而非按解决的行为瓶颈组织。需要统一框架来理解这些方法如何干预模型行为。
AI.method: 提出基于轨迹来源（外部轨迹的离策略学习 vs 学习者生成轨迹的在线策略学习）的分类框架，并通过两个核心角色（支持扩展使有用行为更可达，策略重塑改进可达区域内的行为）和系统级角色（行为整合）来解读方法。
AI.result: 该框架为后训练方法提供统一解读：SFT可服务于支持扩展或策略重塑，基于偏好的方法通常是离策略重塑，在线RL改进学习者生成状态上的行为，蒸馏是行为整合而非仅压缩，混合管道是协调的多阶段组合。
AI.conclusion: LLM后训练的进展日益依赖于协调的系统设计而非单一主导目标。该框架有助于诊断后训练瓶颈和推理阶段组合，强调后训练应理解为对模型行为的结构化干预。

title: Agentivism: a learning theory for the age of artificial intelligence
summary: Learning theories have historically changed when the conditions of learning evolved. Generative and agentic AI create a new condition by allowing learners to delegate explanation, writing, problem solving, and other cognitive work to systems that can generate, recommend, and sometimes act on the learner's behalf. This creates a fundamental challenge for learning theory: successful performance can no longer be assumed to indicate learning. Learners may complete tasks effectively with AI support while developing less understanding, weaker judgment, and limited transferable capability. We argue that this problem is not fully captured by existing learning theories. Behaviourism, cognitivism, constructivism, and connectivism remain important, but they do not directly explain when AI-assisted performance becomes durable human capability. We propose Agentivism, a learning theory for human-AI interaction. Agentivism defines learning as durable growth in human capability through selective delegation to AI, epistemic monitoring and verification of AI contributions, reconstructive internalization of AI-assisted outputs, and transfer under reduced support. The importance of Agentivism lies in explaining how learning remains possible when intelligent delegation is easy and human-AI interaction is becoming a persistent and expanding part of human learning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"能动主义"学习理论，解释在AI辅助下人类如何通过选择性委托、认知监控、重构内化和迁移应用来发展持久能力。
AI.motivation: 生成式和代理式AI允许学习者将认知工作委托给AI系统，这导致传统学习理论面临挑战：成功完成任务不再等同于学习。现有行为主义、认知主义、建构主义和连接主义理论无法解释AI辅助表现何时转化为持久的人类能力。
AI.method: 提出"能动主义"学习理论，定义学习为通过四个关键过程实现的持久能力增长：1)选择性委托给AI；2)对AI贡献的认知监控和验证；3)AI辅助输出的重构性内化；4)在减少支持下的迁移应用。
AI.result: 能动主义理论为人类-AI交互学习提供了新的理论框架，解释了在智能委托变得容易且人机交互成为学习常态的情况下，学习如何仍然可能发生。
AI.conclusion: 能动主义是适应AI时代的学习理论，它解释了人类如何在AI辅助下发展持久能力，为理解人机协作学习提供了必要的理论工具。

title: FlowGuard: Towards Lightweight In-Generation Safety Detection for Diffusion Models via Linear Latent Decoding
summary: Diffusion-based image generation models have advanced rapidly but pose a safety risk due to their potential to generate Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content. Existing NSFW detection methods mainly operate either before or after image generation. Pre-generation methods rely on text prompts and struggle with the gap between prompt safety and image safety. Post-generation methods apply classifiers to final outputs, but they are poorly suited to intermediate noisy images. To address this, we introduce FlowGuard, a cross-model in-generation detection framework that inspects intermediate denoising steps. This is particularly challenging in latent diffusion, where early-stage noise obscures visual signals. FlowGuard employs a novel linear approximation for latent decoding and leverages a curriculum learning approach to stabilize training. By detecting unsafe content early, FlowGuard reduces unnecessary diffusion steps to cut computational costs. Our cross-model benchmark spanning nine diffusion-based backbones shows the effectiveness of FlowGuard for in-generation NSFW detection in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, outperforming existing methods by over 30% in F1 score while delivering transformative efficiency gains, including slashing peak GPU memory demand by over 97% and projection time from 8.1 seconds to 0.2 seconds compared to standard VAE decoding.

AI.tldr: FlowGuard是一个跨模型的生成中NSFW检测框架，通过在去噪过程中检查中间图像来早期检测不安全内容，相比现有方法在F1分数上提升超过30%，同时大幅降低计算成本和GPU内存需求。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的图像生成模型存在生成NSFW内容的安全风险。现有检测方法要么依赖文本提示（生成前），要么在最终输出上应用分类器（生成后），但前者存在提示安全与图像安全之间的差距，后者不适用于中间噪声图像。需要一种能在生成过程中检测不安全内容的方法。
AI.method: FlowGuard采用跨模型的生成中检测框架，检查中间去噪步骤。针对潜在扩散中早期噪声掩盖视觉信号的挑战，提出了新颖的潜在解码线性近似方法，并利用课程学习方法来稳定训练。通过早期检测不安全内容，减少不必要的扩散步骤以降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在九个基于扩散的主干网络上进行的跨模型基准测试显示，FlowGuard在分布内和分布外设置中都有效，F1分数比现有方法高出30%以上。同时带来变革性的效率提升：GPU峰值内存需求降低超过97%，投影时间从8.1秒减少到0.2秒（相比标准VAE解码）。
AI.conclusion: FlowGuard是一个有效的生成中NSFW检测框架，能够在扩散模型的去噪过程中早期检测不安全内容，显著优于现有方法，同时大幅降低计算成本和内存需求，为安全图像生成提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Rethinking Data Mixing from the Perspective of Large Language Models
summary: Data mixing strategy is essential for large language model (LLM) training. Empirical evidence shows that inappropriate strategies can significantly reduce generalization. Although recent methods have improved empirical performance, several fundamental questions remain open: what constitutes a domain, whether human and model perceptions of domains are aligned, and how domain weighting influences generalization. We address these questions by establishing formal connections between gradient dynamics and domain distributions, offering a theoretical framework that clarifies the role of domains in training dynamics. Building on this analysis, we introduce DoGraph, a reweighting framework that formulates data scheduling as a graph-constrained optimization problem. Extensive experiments on GPT-2 models of varying scales demonstrate that DoGraph consistently achieves competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了LLM训练中的数据混合策略，提出了DoGraph框架，通过图约束优化解决数据调度问题，在不同规模的GPT-2模型上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 数据混合策略对LLM训练至关重要，但现有方法存在基本问题：如何定义领域、人类与模型对领域的认知是否一致、领域权重如何影响泛化能力。这些问题缺乏理论框架支撑。
AI.method: 建立了梯度动态与领域分布之间的形式化联系，提出了理论框架。在此基础上引入DoGraph，将数据调度建模为图约束优化问题。
AI.result: 在不同规模的GPT-2模型上进行广泛实验，DoGraph始终取得有竞争力的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论分析阐明了领域在训练动态中的作用，提出的DoGraph框架为数据调度提供了有效的解决方案。

title: AtomEval: Atomic Evaluation of Adversarial Claims in Fact Verification
summary: Adversarial claim rewriting is widely used to test fact-checking systems, but standard metrics fail to capture truth-conditional consistency and often label semantically corrupted rewrites as successful. We introduce AtomEval, a validity-aware evaluation framework that decomposes claims into subject-relation-object-modifier (SROM) atoms and scores adversarial rewrites with Atomic Validity Scoring (AVS), enabling detection of factual corruption beyond surface similarity.
