Experiments on the FEVER dataset across representative attack strategies and LLM generators show that AtomEval provides more reliable evaluation signals in our experiments. Using AtomEval, we further analyze LLM-based adversarial generators and observe that stronger models do not necessarily produce more effective adversarial claims under validity-aware evaluation, highlighting previously overlooked limitations in current adversarial evaluation practices.

AI.tldr: AtomEval是一个基于原子分解的对抗性声明重写评估框架，通过SROM原子分解和原子有效性评分来检测事实性腐败，比传统指标更可靠。
AI.motivation: 当前对抗性声明重写评估中，标准指标无法捕捉真值条件一致性，经常将语义腐败的重写标记为成功，需要更有效的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出AtomEval框架：1）将声明分解为SROM原子（主语-关系-宾语-修饰语）；2）使用原子有效性评分来评估对抗性重写；3）在FEVER数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明AtomEval比传统指标提供更可靠的评估信号，发现更强的LLM模型在有效性感知评估下不一定产生更有效的对抗性声明，揭示了当前对抗性评估实践中被忽视的局限性。
AI.conclusion: AtomEval框架能够有效检测对抗性重写中的事实性腐败，为事实核查系统的评估提供了更可靠的指标，并揭示了LLM生成对抗性声明的局限性。

title: Silencing the Guardrails: Inference-Time Jailbreaking via Dynamic Contextual Representation Ablation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance, they remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety constraints. Existing strategies, ranging from heuristic prompt engineering to computationally intensive optimization, often face significant trade-offs between effectiveness and efficiency. In this work, we propose Contextual Representation Ablation (CRA), a novel inference-time intervention framework designed to dynamically silence model guardrails. Predicated on the geometric insight that refusal behaviors are mediated by specific low-rank subspaces within the model's hidden states, CRA identifies and suppresses these refusal-inducing activation patterns during decoding without requiring expensive parameter updates or training. Empirical evaluation across multiple safety-aligned open-source LLMs demonstrates that CRA significantly outperforms baselines. These results expose the intrinsic fragility of current alignment mechanisms, revealing that safety constraints can be surgically ablated from internal representations, and underscore the urgent need for more robust defenses that secure the model's latent space.

AI.tldr: CRA是一种新颖的推理时干预框架，通过动态沉默模型防护机制来对抗越狱攻击，基于几何洞察识别并抑制隐藏状态中的拒绝诱导激活模式，无需参数更新或训练。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然性能卓越，但仍易受越狱攻击，现有方法在有效性和效率之间存在显著权衡，需要更高效的防护机制干预方法。
AI.method: 提出上下文表示消融（CRA）框架，基于几何洞察发现拒绝行为由隐藏状态中的特定低秩子空间介导，在解码时识别并抑制这些拒绝诱导激活模式。
AI.result: 在多个安全对齐的开源LLMs上的实证评估表明，CRA显著优于基线方法，暴露了当前对齐机制的内在脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 安全约束可以从内部表示中被精确消融，这揭示了当前对齐机制的脆弱性，并强调了需要更强大的防御机制来保护模型的潜在空间。

title: Reinforcement-Guided Synthetic Data Generation for Privacy-Sensitive Identity Recognition
summary: High-fidelity generative models are increasingly needed in privacy-sensitive scenarios, where access to data is severely restricted due to regulatory and copyright constraints. This scarcity hampers model development--ironically, in settings where generative models are most needed to compensate for the lack of data. This creates a self-reinforcing challenge: limited data leads to poor generative models, which in turn fail to mitigate data scarcity. To break this cycle, we propose a reinforcement-guided synthetic data generation framework that adapts general-domain generative priors to privacy-sensitive identity recognition tasks. We first perform a cold-start adaptation to align a pretrained generator with the target domain, establishing semantic relevance and initial fidelity. Building on this foundation, we introduce a multi-objective reward that jointly optimizes semantic consistency, coverage diversity, and expression richness, guiding the generator to produce both realistic and task-effective samples. During downstream training, a dynamic sample selection mechanism further prioritizes high-utility synthetic samples, enabling adaptive data scaling and improved domain alignment. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our framework significantly improves both generation fidelity and classification accuracy, while also exhibiting strong generalization to novel categories in small-data regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出强化引导的合成数据生成框架，将通用领域生成先验适配到隐私敏感的身份识别任务，通过多目标奖励优化语义一致性、覆盖多样性和表达丰富性，显著提升生成保真度和分类准确性。
AI.motivation: 在隐私敏感场景中，数据访问受限严重阻碍了高保真生成模型的开发，而这类场景恰恰最需要生成模型来弥补数据不足，形成了数据稀缺导致生成模型差、生成模型差又无法缓解数据稀缺的恶性循环。
AI.method: 1) 冷启动适配：将预训练生成器与目标领域对齐，建立语义相关性和初始保真度；2) 多目标奖励：联合优化语义一致性、覆盖多样性和表达丰富性；3) 动态样本选择：在下游训练中优先选择高效用合成样本，实现自适应数据扩展和领域对齐。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该框架显著提高了生成保真度和分类准确性，同时在小数据场景下对新颖类别表现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的强化引导合成数据生成框架有效打破了隐私敏感场景中数据稀缺与生成模型质量之间的恶性循环，为受限数据环境下的高质量生成模型开发提供了可行解决方案。

title: Kathleen: Oscillator-Based Byte-Level Text Classification Without Tokenization or Attention
summary: We present Kathleen, a text classification architecture that operates directly on raw UTF-8 bytes using frequency-domain processing -- requiring no tokenizer, no attention mechanism, and only 733K parameters. Kathleen introduces three novel components: (1) RecurrentOscillatorBanks -- damped sinusoid convolutions with temporal memory for O(L) sequence processing; (2) an FFT-Rotate Wavetable Encoder that maps all 256 byte values using a single learnable vector (256 floats), replacing conventional embedding tables (65K parameters) while improving accuracy; (3) PhaseHarmonics -- a sinusoidal non-linearity with just 6 learnable phase parameters that our ablation identifies as the single most impactful component (+2.6% accuracy, <0.001% of model parameters). Through comprehensive ablation of a 1.8M-parameter predecessor, we show that frequency-domain components systematically outperform complex cognitive architectures: removing a 560K-parameter bio-inspired framework costs only -0.2%, while removing the 6-parameter PhaseHarmonics costs -2.6%. The resulting Kathleen-Clean achieves 88.6% on IMDB, 92.3% on AG News, and 83.3% on SST-2 -- outperforming a tokenized counterpart with 16x more parameters on IMDB (+1.6%) and AG News (+2.1%). Kathleen processes sequences in O(L) time and memory, enabling byte-level operation at sequence lengths where O(L^2) Transformers exhaust GPU memory.

AI.tldr: Kathleen是一种基于频域处理的文本分类架构，直接在原始UTF-8字节上操作，无需分词器、注意力机制，仅733K参数，在多个基准测试中优于参数多16倍的模型。
AI.motivation: 传统文本处理需要分词器和注意力机制，导致模型参数庞大且计算复杂度高（O(L^2)）。Kathleen旨在直接在字节级别处理文本，通过频域方法实现高效、轻量级的序列处理。
AI.method: 引入三个创新组件：1) RecurrentOscillatorBanks - 带时间记忆的阻尼正弦卷积，实现O(L)序列处理；2) FFT-Rotate Wavetable Encoder - 使用单个可学习向量（256个浮点数）编码所有256个字节值，替代传统嵌入表；3) PhaseHarmonics - 仅6个可学习相位参数的正弦非线性激活函数。
AI.result: Kathleen-Clean在IMDB上达到88.6%，AG News上92.3%，SST-2上83.3%。在IMDB和AG News上分别比参数多16倍的tokenized模型提升1.6%和2.1%。频域组件系统性优于复杂认知架构：移除560K参数的生物启发框架仅损失0.2%，而移除6参数的PhaseHarmonics损失2.6%。
AI.conclusion: 频域处理为文本分类提供了高效替代方案，Kathleen证明了直接在字节级别操作、使用O(L)复杂度的频域方法可以超越传统tokenized模型，同时显著减少参数数量和计算资源需求。

title: SPARD: Self-Paced Curriculum for RL Alignment via Integrating Reward Dynamics and Data Utility
summary: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) is shifting the focus from single, verifiable tasks toward complex, open-ended real-world scenarios, imposing significant challenges on the post-training phase. In these settings, the scale and complexity of reward systems have grown significantly, transitioning toward multi-objective formulations that encompass a comprehensive spectrum of model capabilities and application contexts. However, traditional methods typically rely on fixed reward weights, ignoring non-stationary learning dynamics and struggling with data heterogeneity across dimensions. To address these issues, we propose SPARD, a framework that establishes an automated, self-paced curriculum by perceiving learning progress to dynamically adjust multi-objective reward weights and data importance, thereby synchronizing learning intent with data utility for optimal performance. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SPARD significantly enhances model capabilities across all domains.

AI.tldr: SPARD框架通过感知学习进度动态调整多目标奖励权重和数据重要性，解决传统固定权重方法在复杂开放场景中的局限性
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的发展从单一可验证任务转向复杂开放场景，传统后训练方法使用固定奖励权重，无法适应非平稳学习动态和数据异质性
AI.method: 提出SPARD框架，建立自动自适应的课程学习机制，通过感知学习进度动态调整多目标奖励权重和数据重要性，实现学习意图与数据效用的同步
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，SPARD显著提升了模型在所有领域的能力
AI.conclusion: SPARD框架通过动态调整奖励权重和数据重要性，有效解决了复杂开放场景中多目标后训练的挑战，为模型能力提升提供了有效解决方案

title: Sampling-Aware 3D Spatial Analysis in Multiplexed Imaging
comment: Accepted to The 11th IEEE Workshop on Computer Vision for Multimodal Microscopy Image Analysis (CVMI), a CVPR 2026 workshop
summary: Highly multiplexed microscopy enables rich spatial characterization of tissues at single-cell resolution, yet most analyses rely on two-dimensional sections despite inherently three-dimensional tissue organization. Acquiring dense volumetric data in spatial proteomics remains costly and technically challenging, leaving practitioners to choose between 2D sections or 3D serial sections under limited imaging budgets. In this work, we study how sampling geometry impacts the stability of commonly used spatial statistics, and we introduce a geometry-aware reconstruction module that enables sparse yet consistent 3D analysis from serial sections. Using controlled simulations, we show that planar sampling reliably recovers global cell-type abundance but exhibits high variance for local statistics such as cell clustering and cell-cell interactions, particularly for rare or spatially localized populations. We observe consistent behavior in real multiplexed datasets, where interaction metrics and neighborhood relationships fluctuate substantially across individual sections. To support sparse 3D analysis in practice, we present a reconstruction approach that links cell projections across adjacent sections using phenotype and proximity constraints and recovers single-cell 3D centroids using cell-type-specific shape priors. We further analyze the trade-off between section spacing, coverage, and redundancy, identifying acquisition regimes that maximize reconstruction utility under fixed imaging budgets. We validate the reconstruction module on a public imaging mass cytometry dataset with dense axial sampling and demonstrate its downstream utility on an in-house CODEX dataset by enabling structure-level 3D analyses that are unreliable in 2D. Together, our results provide diagnostic tools and practical guidance for deciding when 2D sampling suffices and when sparse 3D reconstruction is warranted.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了空间蛋白质组学中2D切片与3D连续切片对空间统计稳定性的影响，提出了几何感知的重建模块，能够在有限成像预算下实现稀疏但一致的3D分析。
AI.motivation: 尽管组织本质上是三维结构，但大多数空间蛋白质组学分析仍依赖二维切片。获取密集的3D数据成本高昂且技术挑战大，研究人员不得不在2D切片和3D连续切片之间做出选择，这限制了空间分析的完整性和准确性。
AI.method: 通过控制模拟研究采样几何对空间统计稳定性的影响；开发几何感知重建模块，利用表型和邻近约束连接相邻切片中的细胞投影，并使用细胞类型特异性形状先验恢复单细胞3D质心；分析切片间距、覆盖范围和冗余度之间的权衡关系。
AI.result: 平面采样能可靠恢复全局细胞类型丰度，但对局部统计（如细胞聚类和细胞间相互作用）方差较大，特别是对于稀有或空间定位的细胞群；在真实数据中观察到相互作用指标和邻域关系在单个切片间波动显著；重建方法在密集轴向采样的公共数据集上得到验证，并在内部CODEX数据集上实现了在2D中不可靠的结构级3D分析。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了诊断工具和实践指导，帮助决定何时2D采样足够，何时需要稀疏3D重建，为在有限成像预算下实现更准确的空间分析提供了实用解决方案。

title: A Decomposition Perspective to Long-context Reasoning for LLMs
summary: Long-context reasoning is essential for complex real-world applications, yet remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite the rapid evolution in long-context reasoning, current research often overlooks the internal complexity of the long-context reasoning task itself. In this paper, we move beyond this holistic view and decompose long-context reasoning into a set of fundamental atomic skills, and we then automatically synthesize a suite of pseudo datasets, each explicitly targeting a specific atomic skill. Our empirical analysis confirms that proficiency in these atomic skills is strongly correlated with general long-text reasoning performance. Building on this insight, we employ reinforcement learning on these pseudo datasets to sharpen the model's atomic skills, in the hope of boosting its general long-context reasoning ability. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach: it outperforms a strong baseline by an average margin of 7.7\% (improving from 46.3\% to 54.0\%) across Loogle, Loong, LongBench-v2, BrowscompLong, Ruler-qa2, and MRCR.

AI.tldr: 该研究将长上下文推理分解为基本原子技能，通过自动合成伪数据集针对每个技能进行强化学习训练，显著提升了LLMs的长文本推理能力。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理对复杂现实应用至关重要，但当前研究往往忽视其内部复杂性，将任务视为整体处理，缺乏对基础技能的针对性训练。
AI.method: 将长上下文推理分解为基本原子技能，自动合成针对每个原子技能的伪数据集，然后在这些数据集上使用强化学习来提升模型的原子技能。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试（Loogle、Loong、LongBench-v2、BrowscompLong、Ruler-qa2、MRCR）上平均提升7.7%（从46.3%提升到54.0%），显著优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解长上下文推理为原子技能并进行针对性训练，可以有效提升LLMs的长文本推理能力，为复杂现实应用提供了新的训练范式。

title: Hidden Biases in Conditioning Autoregressive Models
summary: Large language and music models are increasingly used for constrained generation: rhyming lines, fixed meter, inpainting or infilling, positional endings, and other global form requirements. These systems often perform strikingly well, but the induced procedures are usually not exact conditioning of the underlying autoregressive model. This creates a hidden inferential bias, distinct from the better-known notion of bias inherited from the training set: samples are distorted relative to the true constrained distribution, with no generic guarantee of complete coverage of the admissible solution space or of correct conditional probabilities over valid completions. We formalize several exact inference tasks for autoregressive models and prove corresponding hardness results. For succinctly represented autoregressive models whose next-token probabilities are computable in polynomial time, exact sentence-level maximum a posteriori (MAP) decoding is NP-hard. This hardness persists under unary and metrical constraints. On the sampling side, exact conditioned normalization is \#P-hard even for regular constraints such as fixed-length terminal events. Unlike finite-state Markov models, general autoregressive models do not admit a bounded-state dynamic program for these tasks. These results formalize a standard claim in the neural decoding literature: local autoregressive sampling is easy, whereas exact decoding and exact conditioning under global form constraints are computationally intractable in general.

AI.tldr: 论文证明自回归模型在全局形式约束下的精确推理任务是计算困难的：句子级最大后验解码是NP难的，精确条件归一化是#P难的，这与局部采样形成对比。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言和音乐模型在约束生成（如押韵、固定韵律、填充等）中表现出色，但这些过程通常不是对底层自回归模型的精确条件化。这会产生隐藏的推理偏差，与训练集偏差不同，导致样本相对于真实约束分布失真，且无法保证完全覆盖有效解空间或正确的条件概率。
AI.method: 形式化自回归模型的多个精确推理任务，并证明相应的计算复杂性结果。对于简洁表示的自回归模型（其下一个标记概率可在多项式时间内计算），证明句子级最大后验解码是NP难的，即使在单字符和韵律约束下也成立。在采样方面，证明精确条件归一化是#P难的，即使对于固定长度终端事件等正则约束也是如此。
AI.result: 证明了自回归模型在全局形式约束下的精确推理任务具有计算困难性：句子级MAP解码是NP难的，精确条件归一化是#P难的。与有限状态马尔可夫模型不同，一般自回归模型对这些任务没有有界状态的动态规划算法。
AI.conclusion: 形式化了神经网络解码文献中的标准主张：局部自回归采样容易，而在全局形式约束下的精确解码和精确条件化在计算上通常是难以处理的。这解释了为什么实际系统使用近似方法而非精确条件化。

title: AnomalyAgent: Agentic Industrial Anomaly Synthesis via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
summary: Industrial anomaly generation is a crucial method for alleviating the data scarcity problem in anomaly detection tasks. Most existing anomaly synthesis methods rely on single-step generation mechanisms, lacking complex reasoning and iterative optimization capabilities, making it difficult to generate anomaly samples with high semantic realism. We propose AnomalyAgent, an anomaly synthesis agent with self-reflection, knowledge retrieval, and iterative refinement capabilities, aiming to generate realistic and diverse anomalies. Specifically, AnomalyAgent is equipped with five tools: Prompt Generation (PG), Image Generation (IG), Quality Evaluation (QE), Knowledge Retrieval (KR), and Mask Generation (MG), enabling closed-loop optimization. To improve decision-making and self-reflection, we construct structured trajectories from real anomaly images and design a two-stage training framework: supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. This process is driven by a three-part reward mechanism: (1) task rewards to supervise the quality and location rationality of generated anomalies; (2) reflection rewards to train the model's ability to improve anomaly synthesis prompt; (3) behavioral rewards to ensure adherence to the trajectory. On the MVTec-AD dataset, AnomalyAgent achieves IS/IC-L of 2.10/0.33 for anomaly generation, 57.0% classification accuracy using ResNet34, and 99.3%/74.2% AP at the image/pixel level using a simple UNet, surpassing all zero-shot SOTA methods. The code and data will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: AnomalyAgent：一种具有自我反思、知识检索和迭代优化能力的异常合成智能体，通过五工具闭环系统生成高质量工业异常样本，在MVTec-AD数据集上超越现有零样本方法。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测面临数据稀缺问题，现有异常合成方法多依赖单步生成机制，缺乏复杂推理和迭代优化能力，难以生成语义真实的高质量异常样本。
AI.method: 提出AnomalyAgent异常合成智能体，配备五个工具：提示生成、图像生成、质量评估、知识检索和掩码生成，形成闭环优化。采用两阶段训练框架：监督微调后接强化学习，通过三部分奖励机制（任务奖励、反思奖励、行为奖励）驱动训练。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD数据集上，AnomalyAgent在异常生成方面达到IS/IC-L为2.10/0.33，使用ResNet34的分类准确率为57.0%，使用简单UNet在图像/像素级别达到99.3%/74.2%的AP，超越所有零样本SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: AnomalyAgent通过智能体架构和闭环优化机制，能够生成真实多样的工业异常样本，有效缓解异常检测中的数据稀缺问题，为工业视觉检测提供了新的解决方案。

title: Rag Performance Prediction for Question Answering
summary: We address the task of predicting the gain of using RAG (retrieval augmented generation) for question answering with respect to not using it. We study the performance of a few pre-retrieval and post-retrieval predictors originally devised for ad hoc retrieval. We also study a few post-generation predictors, one of which is novel to this study and posts the best prediction quality. Our results show that the most effective prediction approach is a novel supervised predictor that explicitly models the semantic relationships among the question, retrieved passages, and the generated answer.

AI.tldr: 该研究旨在预测在问答任务中使用RAG相对于不使用RAG的性能增益，评估了多种预测方法，发现基于问题、检索段落和生成答案语义关系建模的新型监督预测器效果最佳。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是预测在问答任务中使用检索增强生成(RAG)相对于不使用RAG的性能增益，帮助用户判断何时使用RAG能带来实际效益。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：1) 研究几种原本为特定检索设计的检索前和检索后预测器；2) 研究几种生成后预测器，其中一个是本研究新提出的；3) 开发了一种新型监督预测器，明确建模问题、检索段落和生成答案之间的语义关系。
AI.result: 研究结果显示：1) 生成后预测器表现优于检索前和检索后预测器；2) 本研究新提出的生成后预测器取得了最佳预测质量；3) 最有效的预测方法是新型监督预测器，它明确建模了问题、检索段落和生成答案之间的语义关系。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明，通过建模问题、检索段落和生成答案之间语义关系的监督预测器能够最有效地预测RAG在问答任务中的性能增益，为实际应用提供了有价值的工具。

title: PanoSAM2: Lightweight Distortion- and Memory-aware Adaptions of SAM2 for 360 Video Object Segmentation
summary: 360 video object segmentation (360VOS) aims to predict temporally-consistent masks in 360 videos, offering full-scene coverage, benefiting applications, such as VR/AR and embodied AI. Learning 360VOS model is nontrivial due to the lack of high-quality labeled dataset. Recently, Segment Anything Models (SAMs), especially SAM2 -- with its design of memory module -- shows strong, promptable VOS capability. However, directly using SAM2 for 360VOS yields implausible results as 360 videos suffer from the projection distortion, semantic inconsistency of left-right sides, and sparse object mask information in SAM2's memory. To this end, we propose PanoSAM2, a novel 360VOS framework based on our lightweight distortion- and memory-aware adaptation strategies of SAM2 to achieve reliable 360VOS while retaining SAM2's user-friendly prompting design. Concretely, to tackle the projection distortion and semantic inconsistency issues, we propose a Pano-Aware Decoder with seam-consistent receptive fields and iterative distortion refinement to maintain continuity across the 0/360 degree boundary. Meanwhile, a Distortion-Guided Mask Loss is introduced to weight pixels by distortion magnitude, stressing stretched regions and boundaries. To address the object sparsity issue, we propose a Long-Short Memory Module to maintain a compact long-term object pointer to re-instantiate and align short-term memories, thereby enhancing temporal coherence. Extensive experiments show that PanoSAM2 yields substantial gains over SAM2: +5.6 on 360VOTS and +6.7 on PanoVOS, showing the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: PanoSAM2是一个基于SAM2的360度视频物体分割框架，通过轻量级的失真感知和记忆感知适配策略，解决了360度视频中的投影失真、语义不一致性和SAM2记忆稀疏问题，显著提升了分割性能。
AI.motivation: 360度视频物体分割（360VOS）在VR/AR和具身AI中有重要应用，但缺乏高质量标注数据集。虽然SAM2具有强大的提示式视频物体分割能力，但直接应用于360度视频会产生不理想的结果，因为360度视频存在投影失真、左右边界语义不一致以及SAM2记忆模块中物体掩码信息稀疏等问题。
AI.method: 提出了PanoSAM2框架，包含三个关键技术：1）全景感知解码器，具有接缝一致的感受野和迭代失真细化，保持0/360度边界的连续性；2）失真引导掩码损失，根据失真程度加权像素，强调拉伸区域和边界；3）长短时记忆模块，维护紧凑的长期物体指针来重新实例化并对齐短期记忆，增强时间一致性。
AI.result: 在360VOTS数据集上比SAM2提升5.6分，在PanoVOS数据集上提升6.7分，证明了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: PanoSAM2通过针对360度视频特性的轻量级适配策略，成功解决了投影失真、语义不一致和记忆稀疏问题，显著提升了360度视频物体分割的性能，同时保留了SAM2的用户友好提示设计。

title: Guaranteeing Knowledge Integration with Joint Decoding for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) significantly enhances Large Language Models (LLMs) by providing access to external knowledge. However, current research primarily focuses on retrieval quality, often overlooking the critical ''integration bottleneck'': even when relevant documents are retrieved, LLMs frequently fail to utilize them effectively due to conflicts with their internal parametric knowledge. In this paper, we argue that implicitly resolving this conflict in a single generation pass is suboptimal. We introduce GuarantRAG, a framework that explicitly decouples reasoning from evidence integration. First, we generate an ''Inner-Answer'' based solely on parametric knowledge to capture the model's reasoning flow. Second, to guarantee faithful evidence extraction, we generate a ''Refer-Answer'' using a novel Contrastive DPO objective. This objective treats the parametric Inner-Answer as a negative constraint and the retrieved documents as positive ground truth, forcing the model to suppress internal hallucinations in favor of external evidence during this phase. Finally, rather than naive concatenation or using the DPO trained model directly, we propose a joint decoding mechanism that dynamically fuses the logical coherence of the Inner-Answer with the factual precision of the Refer-Answer at the token level. Experiments on five QA benchmarks demonstrate that GuarantRAG improves accuracy by up to 12.1% and reduces hallucinations by 16.3% compared to standard and dynamic RAG baselines.

AI.tldr: GuarantRAG框架通过显式分离推理和证据整合来解决RAG中的"整合瓶颈"问题，使用Inner-Answer和Refer-Answer双阶段方法，结合对比DPO目标和联合解码机制，显著提升准确率并减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG研究主要关注检索质量，但忽视了"整合瓶颈"问题：即使检索到相关文档，LLM也经常无法有效利用它们，因为外部证据与模型内部参数知识存在冲突。隐式解决这种冲突的单次生成方法效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出GuarantRAG框架，包含三个步骤：1) 基于参数知识生成Inner-Answer捕获推理流程；2) 使用新颖的对比DPO目标生成Refer-Answer，将参数Inner-Answer作为负约束，检索文档作为正真值，强制模型抑制内部幻觉；3) 提出联合解码机制，在token级别动态融合Inner-Answer的逻辑连贯性和Refer-Answer的事实精确性。
AI.result: 在五个QA基准测试中，GuarantRAG相比标准和动态RAG基线，准确率提升高达12.1%，幻觉减少16.3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离推理和证据整合比隐式方法更有效，GuarantRAG通过双阶段生成和联合解码机制，显著提升了RAG系统的准确性和事实性，为解决LLM整合外部知识时的冲突问题提供了有效方案。

title: DialBGM: A Benchmark for Background Music Recommendation from Everyday Multi-Turn Dialogues
summary: Selecting an appropriate background music (BGM) that supports natural human conversation is a common production step in media and interactive systems. In this paper, we introduce dialogue-conditioned BGM recommendation, where a model should select non-intrusive, fitting music for a multi-turn conversation that often contains no music descriptors. To study this novel problem, we present DialBGM, a benchmark of 1,200 open-domain daily dialogues, each paired with four candidate music clips and annotated with human preference rankings. Rankings are determined by background suitability criteria, including contextual relevance, non-intrusiveness, and consistency. We evaluate a wide range of open-source and proprietary models, including audio-language models and multimodal LLMs, and show that current models fall far short of human judgments; no model exceeds 35% Hit@1 when selecting the top-ranked clip. DialBGM provides a standardized benchmark for developing discourse-aware methods for BGM selection and for evaluating both retrieval-based and generative models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了对话条件背景音乐推荐的新问题，创建了DialBGM基准数据集，包含1200个日常对话及对应音乐片段的人类偏好排序，评估发现现有模型表现远低于人类水平。
AI.motivation: 在媒体和交互系统中，为自然人类对话选择合适的背景音乐是一个常见但具有挑战性的生产步骤。当前缺乏针对对话条件背景音乐推荐的研究和标准化评估基准。
AI.method: 提出了对话条件背景音乐推荐的新问题，创建了DialBGM基准数据集，包含1200个开放域日常对话，每个对话配对4个候选音乐片段，并标注了基于背景适宜性标准的人类偏好排序。评估了包括音频-语言模型和多模态大语言模型在内的多种开源和专有模型。
AI.result: 当前模型表现远低于人类判断水平，没有模型在选择排名第一的音乐片段时超过35%的命中率。DialBGM为开发对话感知的背景音乐选择方法和评估检索与生成模型提供了标准化基准。
AI.conclusion: 对话条件背景音乐推荐是一个具有挑战性的新问题，现有模型表现有限。DialBGM基准为未来研究提供了标准化评估框架，有助于推动对话感知背景音乐选择方法的发展。

title: Efficient Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography via Range Coding
summary: Linguistic steganography involves embedding secret messages within seemingly innocuous texts to enable covert communication. Provable security, which is a long-standing goal and key motivation, has been extended to language-model-based steganography. Previous provably secure approaches have achieved perfect imperceptibility, measured by zero Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, but at the expense of embedding capacity. In this paper, we attempt to directly use a classic entropy coding method (range coding) to achieve secure steganography, and then propose an efficient and provably secure linguistic steganographic method with a rotation mechanism. Experiments across various language models show that our method achieves around 100% entropy utilization (embedding efficiency) for embedding capacity, outperforming the existing baseline methods. Moreover, it achieves high embedding speeds (up to 1554.66 bits/s on GPT-2). The code is available at github.com/ryehr/RRC_steganography.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于范围编码和旋转机制的高效可证明安全的语言隐写方法，在保持完美不可感知性的同时实现了接近100%的熵利用率，显著提升了嵌入容量和速度。
AI.motivation: 语言隐写需要在看似正常的文本中嵌入秘密信息以实现隐蔽通信。可证明安全性是该领域长期追求的目标，但现有方法在实现完美不可感知性（零KL散度）的同时牺牲了嵌入容量。本文旨在解决这一权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于经典熵编码方法（范围编码）的可证明安全语言隐写方法，并引入了旋转机制。该方法利用语言模型的概率分布进行信息嵌入，同时通过理论证明确保安全性。
AI.result: 在不同语言模型上的实验表明，该方法实现了约100%的熵利用率（嵌入效率），优于现有基线方法。嵌入速度高达1554.66比特/秒（在GPT-2上），同时保持了完美不可感知性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的RRC（范围编码加旋转机制）方法在保持可证明安全性的同时，显著提高了语言隐写的嵌入容量和效率，为实际应用提供了高效可行的解决方案。

title: Visual Perceptual to Conceptual First-Order Rule Learning Networks
summary: Learning rules plays a crucial role in deep learning, particularly in explainable artificial intelligence and enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models. While existing rule learning methods are primarily designed for symbolic data, learning rules from image data without supporting image labels and automatically inventing predicates remains a challenge. In this paper, we tackle these inductive rule learning problems from images with a framework called γILP, which provides a fully differentiable pipeline from image constant substitution to rule structure induction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that γILP achieves strong performance not only on classical symbolic relational datasets but also on relational image data and pure image datasets, such as Kandinsky patterns.

AI.tldr: γILP是一个从图像数据中学习归纳规则的框架，无需图像标签支持，能自动发明谓词，在符号关系数据集和图像数据集上均表现良好。
AI.motivation: 现有规则学习方法主要针对符号数据，而从图像数据中学习规则（无需图像标签支持且能自动发明谓词）仍是一个挑战。本文旨在解决从图像中进行归纳规则学习的问题。
AI.method: 提出γILP框架，提供从图像常量替换到规则结构归纳的完全可微分管道，支持从图像数据中学习规则并自动发明谓词。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，γILP不仅在经典符号关系数据集上表现优异，在关系图像数据和纯图像数据集（如Kandinsky模式）上也取得了强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: γILP成功解决了从图像数据中学习归纳规则的挑战，为可解释人工智能和增强大语言模型推理能力提供了有效工具。

title: Mitigating Entangled Steering in Large Vision-Language Models for Hallucination Reduction
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable success across cross-modal tasks but remain hindered by hallucinations, producing textual outputs inconsistent with visual content. Existing methods mitigate hallucinations but often alter generation behavior, resulting in shorter outputs and shifted token distributions, especially in latent space steering approaches. We identify that this issue stems from entangled steering signals, where suppressing hallucinations inadvertently disrupts the model's intrinsic generation behavior. To address this, we propose MESA, an effective plug-and-play framework that performs controlled and selective latent intervention for hallucination mitigation. Specifically, MESA targets hallucination-relevant responses while preserving the model's original token distribution, enabling effective hallucination reduction without compromising generation behavior. Extensive experiments across diverse generative and discriminative benchmarks demonstrate that MESA consistently reduces hallucinations while better preserving generation behavior, outperforming prior methods across multiple LVLM families.

AI.tldr: MESA：一种用于缓解大型视觉语言模型幻觉的即插即用框架，通过选择性潜在干预在减少幻觉的同时保持模型原始生成行为
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在跨模态任务中取得显著成功，但仍受幻觉问题困扰，即文本输出与视觉内容不一致。现有方法虽然能缓解幻觉，但往往会改变模型的生成行为，导致输出变短和词元分布偏移，特别是在潜在空间引导方法中。问题根源在于引导信号纠缠，抑制幻觉时无意中破坏了模型的内在生成行为。
AI.method: 提出MESA框架，这是一种有效的即插即用框架，执行受控和选择性的潜在干预来缓解幻觉。具体来说，MESA针对幻觉相关响应进行干预，同时保持模型的原始词元分布，从而在不损害生成行为的情况下有效减少幻觉。
AI.result: 在多样化的生成式和判别式基准测试上进行广泛实验，结果表明MESA能够持续减少幻觉，同时更好地保持生成行为，在多个LVLM家族中优于先前的方法。
AI.conclusion: MESA通过选择性潜在干预有效解决了现有幻觉缓解方法改变模型生成行为的问题，在减少幻觉的同时保持了模型的原始生成特性，为大型视觉语言模型的幻觉缓解提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Dual-Pool Token-Budget Routing for Cost-Efficient and Reliable LLM Serving
summary: Production vLLM fleets typically provision each instance for the worst-case context length, leading to substantial KV-cache over-allocation and under-utilized concurrency. In practice, 80-95% of requests are short, yet are served under configurations optimized for long contexts, wasting 4-8$\times$ throughput capacity and triggering reliability issues such as OOM crashes, preemption, and request rejections. We identify a common root cause for these inefficiencies: configuration-traffic mismatch. We propose dual-pool token-budget routing, a lightweight dispatch mechanism that partitions a homogeneous fleet into two specialized pools: a high-throughput short-context pool and a high-capacity long-context pool. Each request is routed based on its estimated total token budget, computed using a per-category bytes-to-token ratio that is learned online via exponential moving average from usage.prompt_tokens feedback, eliminating the need for a tokenizer. We also develop a simple analytical model that predicts fleet-level cost savings from workload characteristics and measured throughput differences, enabling practitioners to estimate benefits prior to deployment. Evaluations on real-world traces from the Azure LLM Inference Dataset and LMSYS-Chat-1M, serving Llama-3-70B on A100 GPUs, show that our approach reduces GPU-hours by 31-42%, corresponding to \$2.86M annual savings at fleet scale, while lowering preemption rates by 5.4$\times$ and improving P99 TTFT by 6%. A case study with Qwen3-235B-A22B on AMD MI300X at 10,000 req/s projects \$15.4M in annual savings. The method incurs only O(1) dispatch overhead, adapts automatically to heterogeneous workloads, and composes seamlessly with existing optimizations such as PagedAttention, continuous batching, and prefill-decode disaggregation.

AI.tldr: 提出双池令牌预算路由机制，通过将同质推理集群划分为短上下文高吞吐池和长上下文高容量池，根据请求的令牌预算进行智能路由，解决KV缓存过度分配问题，显著提升GPU利用率和系统可靠性。
AI.motivation: 生产vLLM集群通常按最坏情况上下文长度配置，导致KV缓存过度分配和并发利用率低。实际中80-95%请求是短上下文，却在为长上下文优化的配置下服务，浪费4-8倍吞吐容量，并引发OOM崩溃、抢占和请求拒绝等可靠性问题。
AI.method: 提出双池令牌预算路由机制：将同质集群划分为短上下文高吞吐池和长上下文高容量池。通过在线学习的字节到令牌比率（使用指数移动平均从usage.prompt_tokens反馈学习）估计请求总令牌预算，无需分词器。开发分析模型预测集群级成本节省。
AI.result: 在Azure LLM推理数据集和LMSYS-Chat-1M真实轨迹上，服务Llama-3-70B于A100 GPU，方法减少GPU小时31-42%，对应年节省286万美元，降低抢占率5.4倍，改善P99 TTFT 6%。Qwen3-235B-A22B于AMD MI300X在10,000请求/秒场景下预计年节省1540万美元。
AI.conclusion: 双池令牌预算路由机制有效解决配置-流量不匹配问题，仅需O(1)调度开销，自动适应异构工作负载，与现有优化（如PagedAttention、连续批处理、预填充-解码解耦）无缝组合，显著提升生产vLLM集群的效率和可靠性。

title: Capture-Quiet Decomposition: A Verification Theorem for Chess Endgame Tablebases
comment: 9 pages, 3 tables. Validated on 517 endgames covering 6.5 billion positions
summary: We present the Capture-Quiet Decomposition (CQD), a structural theorem for verifying Win-Draw-Loss (WDL) labelings of chess endgame tablebases. The theorem decomposes every legal position into exactly one of three categories -- terminal, capture, or quiet -- and shows that a WDL labeling is correct if and only if: (1) terminal positions are labeled correctly, (2) capture positions are consistent with verified sub-models of smaller piece count, and (3) quiet positions satisfy retrograde consistency within the same endgame. The key insight is that capture positions anchor the labeling to externally verified sub-models, breaking the circularity that allows trivial fixpoints (such as the all-draw labeling) to satisfy self-consistency alone. We validate CQD exhaustively on all 35 three- and four-piece endgames (42 million positions), all 110 five-piece endgames, and all 372 six-piece endgames -- 517 endgames in total -- with the decomposed verifier producing identical violation counts to a full retrograde baseline in every case.

AI.tldr: 提出捕获-静止分解定理，用于验证国际象棋残局数据库的胜负和标签，通过将位置分为终端、捕获、静止三类，解决自一致性验证中的循环依赖问题。
AI.motivation: 验证国际象棋残局数据库的胜负和标签时，传统的自一致性验证存在循环依赖问题，容易产生平凡解（如全部标记为和棋），需要一种能打破循环依赖的验证方法。
AI.method: 提出捕获-静止分解定理，将每个合法位置分解为三类：终端位置、捕获位置、静止位置。验证胜负和标签的正确性需要满足三个条件：终端位置标签正确、捕获位置与已验证的较少棋子子模型一致、静止位置在同一残局内满足逆向一致性。
AI.result: 在全部35个三子和四子残局（4200万位置）、110个五子残局、372个六子残局，总计517个残局上进行了全面验证，分解验证器与完整逆向基准在所有情况下产生相同的违规计数。
AI.conclusion: 捕获-静止分解定理提供了一种有效的结构定理，通过将捕获位置锚定到外部验证的子模型，打破了自一致性验证中的循环依赖，能够可靠地验证国际象棋残局数据库的胜负和标签。

title: Tarot-SAM3: Training-free SAM3 for Any Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: Referring Expression Segmentation (RES) aims to segment image regions described by natural-language expressions, serving as a bridge between vision and language understanding. Existing RES methods, however, rely heavily on large annotated datasets and are limited to either explicit or implicit expressions, hindering their ability to generalize to any referring expression. Recently, the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) has shown impressive robustness in Promptable Concept Segmentation. Nonetheless, applying it to RES remains challenging: (1) SAM3 struggles with longer or implicit expressions; (2) naive coupling of SAM3 with a multimodal large language model (MLLM) makes the final results overly dependent on the MLLM's reasoning capability, without enabling refinement of SAM3's segmentation outputs. To this end, we present Tarot-SAM3, a novel training-free framework that can accurately segment from any referring expression. Specifically, Tarot-SAM3 consists of two key phases. First, the Expression Reasoning Interpreter (ERI) phase introduces reasoning-assisted prompt options to support structured expression parsing and evaluation-aware rephrasing. This transforms arbitrary queries into robust heterogeneous prompts for generating reliable masks with SAM3. Second, the Mask Self-Refining (MSR) phase selects the best mask across prompt types and performs self-refinement by leveraging rich feature relationships from DINOv3 to compare discriminative regions among ERI outputs. It then infers region affiliation to the target, thereby correcting over- and under-segmentation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Tarot-SAM3 achieves strong performance on both explicit and implicit RES benchmarks, as well as open-world scenarios. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each phase.

AI.tldr: Tarot-SAM3是一个无需训练的新框架，通过两阶段方法解决任意指称表达式的分割问题：第一阶段使用推理辅助提示选项将查询转换为可靠提示，第二阶段通过自精炼机制优化分割结果。
AI.motivation: 现有指称表达式分割方法依赖大规模标注数据，且只能处理显式或隐式表达中的一种，缺乏泛化能力。虽然SAM3在可提示概念分割中表现出色，但直接应用于RES存在两个挑战：处理长或隐式表达困难，以及简单结合MLLM会导致结果过度依赖MLLM的推理能力。
AI.method: Tarot-SAM3包含两个关键阶段：1）表达式推理解释器阶段，引入推理辅助提示选项，支持结构化表达式解析和评估感知重述，将任意查询转换为可靠的异构提示；2）掩码自精炼阶段，跨提示类型选择最佳掩码，利用DINOv3的丰富特征关系比较判别区域，推断区域与目标的隶属关系，纠正过分割和欠分割。
AI.result: 实验表明Tarot-SAM3在显式和隐式RES基准测试以及开放世界场景中都取得了强劲性能。消融研究进一步验证了每个阶段的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Tarot-SAM3是一个无需训练的框架，能够准确分割任意指称表达式，通过推理辅助提示生成和掩码自精炼机制，有效解决了现有方法的局限性，在多种场景下表现出色。

title: SAT: Balancing Reasoning Accuracy and Efficiency with Stepwise Adaptive Thinking
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized complex problem-solving, yet they exhibit a pervasive "overthinking", generating unnecessarily long reasoning chains. While current solutions improve token efficiency, they often sacrifice fine-grained control or risk disrupting the logical integrity of the reasoning process. To address this, we introduce Stepwise Adaptive Thinking (SAT), a framework that performs step-level, difficulty-aware pruning while preserving the core reasoning structure. SAT formulates reasoning as a Finite-State Machine (FSM) with distinct thinking modes (Slow, Normal, Fast, Skip). It navigates these states dynamically using a lightweight Process Reward Model (PRM), compressing easy steps while preserving depth for hard ones. Experiments across 9 LRMs and 7 benchmarks show that SAT achieves up to 40% reduction in reasoning tokens while generally maintaining or improving accuracy.

AI.tldr: SAT框架通过有限状态机和轻量级奖励模型实现步级自适应剪枝，在减少40%推理令牌的同时保持或提升准确性
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型存在普遍"过度思考"问题，生成不必要的长推理链。现有解决方案在提升令牌效率时，往往牺牲细粒度控制或破坏推理过程的逻辑完整性。
AI.method: 提出Stepwise Adaptive Thinking (SAT)框架，将推理建模为有限状态机，包含慢速、正常、快速、跳过四种思考模式。使用轻量级过程奖励模型动态导航这些状态，对简单步骤进行压缩，对困难步骤保持推理深度。
AI.result: 在9个大型推理模型和7个基准测试上的实验表明，SAT实现了高达40%的推理令牌减少，同时通常保持或提高了准确性。
AI.conclusion: SAT框架通过步级、难度感知的剪枝方法，在保持核心推理结构完整性的同时，有效解决了大型推理模型的"过度思考"问题，实现了推理效率与准确性的平衡。

title: Stitch4D: Sparse Multi-Location 4D Urban Reconstruction via Spatio-Temporal Interpolation
summary: Dynamic urban environments are often captured by cameras placed at spatially separated locations with little or no view overlap. However, most existing 4D reconstruction methods assume densely overlapping views. When applied to such sparse observations, these methods fail to reconstruct intermediate regions and often introduce temporal artifacts. To address this practical yet underexplored sparse multi-location setting, we propose Stitch4D, a unified 4D reconstruction framework that explicitly compensates for missing spatial coverage in sparse observations. Stitch4D (i) synthesizes intermediate bridge views to densify spatial constraints and improve spatial coverage, and (ii) jointly optimizes real and synthesized observations within a unified coordinate frame under explicit inter-location consistency constraints. By restoring intermediate coverage before optimization, Stitch4D prevents geometric collapse and reconstructs coherent geometry and smooth scene dynamics even in sparsely observed environments. To evaluate this setting, we introduce Urban Sparse 4D (U-S4D), a CARLA-based benchmark designed to assess spatiotemporal alignment under sparse multi-location configurations. Experimental results on U-S4D show that Stitch4D surpasses representative 4D reconstruction baselines and achieves superior visual quality. These results indicate that recovering intermediate spatial coverage is essential for stable 4D reconstruction in sparse urban environments.

AI.tldr: Stitch4D是一个针对稀疏多摄像头场景的4D重建框架，通过合成中间桥接视图来弥补空间覆盖不足，在稀疏观测下实现稳定的时空重建。
AI.motivation: 现有4D重建方法通常假设密集重叠的视角，但在实际城市环境中，摄像头通常空间分离且视角重叠很少。这种稀疏观测导致中间区域无法重建并产生时间伪影，需要专门的方法来解决这一实际问题。
AI.method: Stitch4D采用两阶段方法：(1) 合成中间桥接视图以增加空间约束和覆盖范围；(2) 在统一的坐标系下联合优化真实和合成观测，并施加明确的跨位置一致性约束。通过恢复中间覆盖来防止几何崩溃。
AI.result: 在提出的Urban Sparse 4D基准测试上，Stitch4D超越了代表性的4D重建基线方法，实现了优越的视觉质量。结果表明恢复中间空间覆盖对于稀疏城市环境中的稳定4D重建至关重要。
AI.conclusion: Stitch4D通过显式补偿稀疏观测中的空间覆盖缺失，能够在稀疏多位置配置下重建连贯的几何和平滑的场景动态，为解决实际城市环境中的4D重建问题提供了有效方案。

title: Initialisation Determines the Basin: Efficient Codebook Optimisation for Extreme LLM Quantization
comment: 9 pages (+ references and appendix). Under review at ACL Rolling Review
summary: Additive quantization enables extreme LLM compression with O(1) lookup-table dequantization, making it attractive for edge deployment. Yet at 2-bit precision, it often fails catastrophically, even with extensive search and finetuning. We show that the dominant bottleneck is codebook initialisation. Greedy sequential initialisation frequently places the model in poor optimisation regions that subsequent beam search and PV-tuning struggle to overcome. We analyse this behaviour through the representational ratio \r{ho} = N/KM, which characterises the relationship between weight groups and codebook capacity, and propose OA-EM, an output-aware EM initialisation method using Hessian-weighted Mahalanobis distance. Across compression rates, search budgets, and three architectures (Llama 3.2 3B, Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 2.5 3B), OA-EM consistently produces better solutions after PV-tuning and dominates the quality-compute frontier. The severity of the bottleneck scales with \r{ho}: moderate at 3 bpp but extreme at 2 bpp, where poor initialisation can degrade perplexity by orders of magnitude. More broadly, our results highlight the importance of optimisation geometry in compressed model spaces, where initialisation can dominate subsequent search and fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在2位精度下，加法量化的主要瓶颈是码本初始化问题。传统的贪婪顺序初始化方法会将模型置于不良优化区域，后续的波束搜索和PV调优难以克服。作者提出了输出感知的EM初始化方法OA-EM，显著提升了压缩模型的质量。
AI.motivation: 加法量化能够在边缘部署中实现极端的LLM压缩，但在2位精度下经常失败。研究发现主要瓶颈在于码本初始化，传统方法导致模型陷入不良优化区域，后续优化难以改善。
AI.method: 提出OA-EM（输出感知EM初始化）方法，使用Hessian加权的马氏距离进行初始化。通过表征比率ρ = N/KM分析权重组与码本容量关系，在不同压缩率、搜索预算和三种架构（Llama 3.2 3B、Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 2.5 3B）上进行验证。
AI.result: OA-EM在PV调优后始终产生更好的解决方案，主导了质量-计算前沿。初始化瓶颈的严重程度随ρ缩放：在3 bpp时中等，在2 bpp时极端，不良初始化可使困惑度下降数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 初始化在压缩模型空间的优化几何中至关重要，可以主导后续的搜索和微调。OA-EM方法有效解决了加法量化在极端压缩下的初始化瓶颈问题。

title: EigentSearch-Q+: Enhancing Deep Research Agents with Structured Reasoning Tools
summary: Deep research requires reasoning over web evidence to answer open-ended questions, and it is a core capability for AI agents. Yet many deep research agents still rely on implicit, unstructured search behavior that causes redundant exploration and brittle evidence aggregation. Motivated by Anthropic's "think" tool paradigm and insights from the information-retrieval literature, we introduce Q+, a set of query and evidence processing tools that make web search more deliberate by guiding query planning, monitoring search progress, and extracting evidence from long web snapshots. We integrate Q+ into the browser sub-agent of Eigent, an open-source, production-ready multi-agent workforce for computer use, yielding EigentSearch-Q+. Across four benchmarks (SimpleQA-Verified, FRAMES, WebWalkerQA, and X-Bench DeepSearch), Q+ improves Eigent's browser agent benchmark-size-weighted average accuracy by 3.0, 3.8, and 0.6 percentage points (pp) for GPT-4.1, GPT-5.1, and Minimax M2.5 model backends, respectively. Case studies further suggest that EigentSearch-Q+ produces more coherent tool-calling trajectories by making search progress and evidence handling explicit.

AI.tldr: Q+是一套查询和证据处理工具，通过引导查询规划、监控搜索进度和从长网页快照中提取证据，使网络搜索更加审慎，提升了深度研究代理的性能。
AI.motivation: 许多深度研究代理仍然依赖隐式、非结构化的搜索行为，导致冗余探索和脆弱的证据聚合。受Anthropic的"思考"工具范式和信息检索文献的启发，需要更审慎的搜索方法。
AI.method: 引入Q+工具集，包括查询规划、搜索进度监控和从长网页快照中提取证据的功能。将Q+集成到Eigent的浏览器子代理中，形成EigentSearch-Q+系统。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中，Q+显著提升了Eigent浏览器代理的性能：GPT-4.1提升3.0个百分点，GPT-5.1提升3.8个百分点，Minimax M2.5提升0.6个百分点。案例研究显示工具调用轨迹更加连贯。
AI.conclusion: Q+通过使搜索进度和证据处理显式化，提高了深度研究代理的性能和工具调用的连贯性，为AI代理的深度研究能力提供了有效工具支持。

title: Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting for Arbitrary-ResolutionAtmospheric Downscaling and Forecasting
summary: While AI-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) enables rapid forecasting, generating high-resolution outputs remains computationally demanding due to limited multi-scale adaptability and inefficient data representations. We propose the 3D Gaussian splatting-based scale-aware vision transformer (GSSA-ViT), a novel framework for arbitrary-resolution forecasting and flexible downscaling of high-dimensional atmospheric fields. Specifically, latitude-longitude grid points are treated as centers of 3D Gaussians. A generative 3D Gaussian prediction scheme is introduced to estimate key parameters, including covariance, attributes, and opacity, for unseen samples, improving generalization and mitigating overfitting. In addition, a scale-aware attention module is designed to capture cross-scale dependencies, enabling the model to effectively integrate information across varying downscaling ratios and support continuous resolution adaptation. To our knowledge, this is the first NWP approach that combines generative 3D Gaussian modeling with scale-aware attention for unified multi-scale prediction. Experiments on ERA5 show that the proposed method accurately forecasts 87 atmospheric variables at arbitrary resolutions, while evaluations on ERA5 and CMIP6 demonstrate its superior performance in downscaling tasks. The proposed framework provides an efficient and scalable solution for high-resolution, multi-scale atmospheric prediction and downscaling. Code is available at: https://github.com/binbin2xs/weather-GS.

AI.tldr: 提出GSSA-ViT框架，结合3D高斯建模和尺度感知注意力机制，实现任意分辨率天气预报和多尺度降尺度任务
AI.motivation: AI数值天气预报虽然快速，但生成高分辨率输出计算成本高，主要受限于多尺度适应性和数据表示效率问题
AI.method: 将经纬网格点视为3D高斯中心，引入生成式3D高斯预测方案估计协方差、属性和不透明度等参数；设计尺度感知注意力模块捕捉跨尺度依赖关系
AI.result: 在ERA5数据集上准确预测87个大气变量，在ERA5和CMIP6数据集上表现出优越的降尺度性能
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高分辨率、多尺度大气预测和降尺度提供了高效可扩展的解决方案，首次将生成式3D高斯建模与尺度感知注意力结合用于统一多尺度预测

title: Shortcut Learning in Glomerular AI: Adversarial Penalties Hurt, Entropy Helps
comment: Accepted at IEEE ISBI 2026. Hien Nguyen and Chandra Mohan jointly supervised this work
summary: Stain variability is a pervasive source of distribution shift and potential shortcut learning in renal pathology AI. We ask whether lupus nephritis glomerular lesion classifiers exploit stain as a shortcut, and how to mitigate such bias without stain or site labels. We curate a multi-center, multi-stain dataset of 9{,}674 glomerular patches (224$\times$224) from 365 WSIs across three centers and four stains (PAS, H\&E, Jones, Trichrome), labeled as proliferative vs.\ non-proliferative. We evaluate Bayesian CNN and ViT backbones with Monte Carlo dropout in three settings: (1) stain-only classification; (2) a dual-head model jointly predicting lesion and stain with supervised stain loss; and (3) a dual-head model with label-free stain regularization via entropy maximization on the stain head. In (1), stain identity is trivially learnable, confirming a strong candidate shortcut. In (2), varying the strength and sign of stain supervision strongly modulates stain performance but leaves lesion metrics essentially unchanged, indicating no measurable stain-driven shortcut learning on this multi-stain, multi-center dataset, while overly adversarial stain penalties inflate predictive uncertainty. In (3), entropy-based regularization holds stain predictions near chance without degrading lesion accuracy or calibration. Overall, a carefully curated multi-stain dataset can be inherently robust to stain shortcuts, and a Bayesian dual-head architecture with label-free entropy regularization offers a simple, deployment-friendly safeguard against potential stain-related drift in glomerular AI.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨肾病理AI中染色变异导致的分布偏移问题，评估狼疮性肾炎肾小球病变分类器是否利用染色作为捷径，并提出无需染色标签的偏差缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 染色变异是肾病理AI中普遍存在的分布偏移来源和潜在的捷径学习问题。研究旨在探究狼疮性肾炎肾小球病变分类器是否利用染色作为捷径，以及如何在不使用染色或站点标签的情况下缓解这种偏差。
AI.method: 构建了多中心、多染色数据集（9,674个肾小球斑块，来自3个中心的365个WSI，4种染色）。评估了贝叶斯CNN和ViT骨干网络在三种设置下的表现：1）仅染色分类；2）双头模型联合预测病变和染色（有监督染色损失）；3）双头模型通过熵最大化进行无标签染色正则化。
AI.result: 1）染色身份可轻松学习，确认了强候选捷径；2）改变染色监督的强度和符号强烈调节染色性能但不改变病变指标，表明在此多染色多中心数据集中未检测到染色驱动的捷径学习；3）基于熵的正则化使染色预测接近随机水平而不降低病变准确性或校准。
AI.conclusion: 精心策划的多染色数据集本身对染色捷径具有鲁棒性，而带有无标签熵正则化的贝叶斯双头架构为肾小球AI中潜在的染色相关漂移提供了简单、易于部署的保障措施。

title: Graph Neural Networks for Misinformation Detection: Performance-Efficiency Trade-offs
comment: Accepted at Computational Modeling and Artificial Intelligence for Social Systems Track in ICCS 2026
summary: The rapid spread of online misinformation has led to increasingly complex detection models, including large language models and hybrid architectures. However, their computational cost and deployment limitations raise concerns about practical applicability. In this work, we benchmark graph neural networks (GNNs) against non-graph-based machine learning methods under controlled and comparable conditions. We evaluate lightweight GNN architectures (GCN, GraphSAGE, GAT, ChebNet) against Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, and Multilayer Perceptrons across seven public datasets in English, Indonesian, and Polish. All models use identical TF-IDF features to isolate the impact of relational structure. Performance is measured using F1 score, with inference time reported to assess efficiency. GNNs consistently outperform non-graph baselines across all datasets. For example, GraphSAGE achieves 96.8% F1 on Kaggle and 91.9% on WELFake, compared to 73.2% and 66.8% for MLP, respectively. On COVID-19, GraphSAGE reaches 90.5% F1 vs. 74.9%, while ChebNet attains 79.1% vs. 66.4% on FakeNewsNet. These gains are achieved with comparable or lower inference times. Overall, the results show that classic GNNs remain effective and efficient, challenging the need for increasingly complex architectures in misinformation detection.

AI.tldr: 该研究在可比条件下对图神经网络（GNN）与非图机器学习方法在虚假信息检测任务上进行基准测试，发现轻量级GNN架构在性能上显著优于传统方法，且推理时间相当或更低。
AI.motivation: 在线虚假信息的快速传播催生了复杂的检测模型，但这些模型的计算成本和部署限制影响了实际应用性。研究旨在评估图神经网络在虚假信息检测中的实际效果和效率。
AI.method: 在可控可比条件下，对轻量级GNN架构（GCN、GraphSAGE、GAT、ChebNet）与逻辑回归、支持向量机、多层感知机进行基准测试。使用7个公开数据集（英语、印尼语、波兰语），所有模型采用相同的TF-IDF特征以隔离关系结构的影响。
AI.result: GNN在所有数据集上一致优于非图基线方法。例如GraphSAGE在Kaggle数据集上达到96.8% F1，在WELFake上达到91.9%，而MLP分别为73.2%和66.8%。在COVID-19数据集上，GraphSAGE达到90.5% F1 vs. 74.9%，ChebNet在FakeNewsNet上达到79.1% vs. 66.4%。这些性能提升是在相当或更低的推理时间内实现的。
AI.conclusion: 经典GNN在虚假信息检测中仍然有效且高效，挑战了对日益复杂架构的需求。轻量级GNN可以作为实际部署的可行选择。

title: WorldMAP: Bootstrapping Vision-Language Navigation Trajectory Prediction with Generative World Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and generative world models are opening new opportunities for embodied navigation. VLMs are increasingly used as direct planners or trajectory predictors, while world models support look-ahead reasoning by imagining future views. Yet predicting a reliable trajectory from a single egocentric observation remains challenging. Current VLMs often generate unstable trajectories, and world models, though able to synthesize plausible futures, do not directly provide the grounded signals needed for navigation learning. This raises a central question: how can generated futures be turned into supervision for grounded trajectory prediction? We present WorldMAP, a teacher--student framework that converts world-model-generated futures into persistent semantic-spatial structure and planning-derived supervision. Its world-model-driven teacher builds semantic-spatial memory from generated videos, grounds task-relevant targets and obstacles, and produces trajectory pseudo-labels through explicit planning. A lightweight student with a multi-hypothesis trajectory head is then trained to predict navigation trajectories directly from vision-language inputs. On Target-Bench, WorldMAP achieves the best ADE and FDE among compared methods, reducing ADE by 18.0% and FDE by 42.1% relative to the best competing baseline, while lifting a small open-source VLM to DTW performance competitive with proprietary models. More broadly, the results suggest that, in embodied navigation, the value of world models may lie less in supplying action-ready imagined evidence than in synthesizing structured supervision for navigation learning.

AI.tldr: WorldMAP框架利用世界模型生成的未来视频构建语义空间记忆，通过显式规划产生轨迹伪标签，训练轻量级学生模型直接从视觉语言输入预测导航轨迹，显著提升轨迹预测精度。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型(VLMs)生成的导航轨迹不稳定，而世界模型虽然能合成可信的未来视图，但无法直接提供导航学习所需的基础信号。核心问题是如何将生成的未来转换为轨迹预测的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出WorldMAP师生框架：世界模型驱动的教师从生成的视频构建语义空间记忆，定位任务相关目标和障碍，通过显式规划产生轨迹伪标签；轻量级学生模型配备多假设轨迹头，直接从视觉语言输入学习预测导航轨迹。
AI.result: 在Target-Bench上，WorldMAP在ADE和FDE指标上表现最佳，相比最佳基线分别降低18.0%和42.1%，将小型开源VLM提升到与专有模型竞争的DTW性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在具身导航中，世界模型的价值可能不在于提供可直接用于行动的想象证据，而在于为导航学习合成结构化监督信号。

title: ImVideoEdit: Image-learning Video Editing via 2D Spatial Difference Attention Blocks
summary: Current video editing models often rely on expensive paired video data, which limits their practical scalability. In essence, most video editing tasks can be formulated as a decoupled spatiotemporal process, where the temporal dynamics of the pretrained model are preserved while spatial content is selectively and precisely modified. Based on this insight, we propose ImVideoEdit, an efficient framework that learns video editing capabilities entirely from image pairs. By freezing the pre-trained 3D attention modules and treating images as single-frame videos, we decouple the 2D spatial learning process to help preserve the original temporal dynamics. The core of our approach is a Predict-Update Spatial Difference Attention module that progressively extracts and injects spatial differences. Rather than relying on rigid external masks, we incorporate a Text-Guided Dynamic Semantic Gating mechanism for adaptive and implicit text-driven modifications. Despite training on only 13K image pairs for 5 epochs with exceptionally low computational overhead, ImVideoEdit achieves editing fidelity and temporal consistency comparable to larger models trained on extensive video datasets.

AI.tldr: ImVideoEdit：仅使用图像对训练的高效视频编辑框架，通过解耦时空处理，冻结3D注意力模块，实现与大型视频数据集训练模型相当的编辑质量和时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 当前视频编辑模型依赖昂贵的配对视频数据，限制了实际可扩展性。大多数视频编辑任务本质上是解耦的时空过程，可以在保持预训练模型时间动态的同时，选择性地精确修改空间内容。
AI.method: 1) 冻结预训练的3D注意力模块，将图像视为单帧视频，解耦2D空间学习过程以保持原始时间动态；2) 核心是预测-更新空间差异注意力模块，逐步提取和注入空间差异；3) 文本引导的动态语义门控机制，实现自适应和隐式的文本驱动修改，无需依赖刚性外部掩码。
AI.result: 仅使用13K图像对训练5个epoch，计算开销极低，但实现了与在大量视频数据集上训练的大型模型相当的编辑保真度和时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: ImVideoEdit展示了仅从图像对学习视频编辑能力的可行性，为视频编辑提供了一种高效、可扩展的解决方案，减少了对昂贵视频数据集的依赖。

title: Clickbait detection: quick inference with maximum impact
summary: We propose a lightweight hybrid approach to clickbait detection that combines OpenAI semantic embeddings with six compact heuristic features capturing stylistic and informational cues. To improve efficiency, embeddings are reduced using PCA and evaluated with XGBoost, GraphSAGE, and GCN classifiers. While the simplified feature design yields slightly lower F1-scores, graph-based models achieve competitive performance with substantially reduced inference time. High ROC--AUC values further indicate strong discrimination capability, supporting reliable detection of clickbait headlines under varying decision thresholds.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级混合点击诱饵检测方法，结合OpenAI语义嵌入与6个启发式特征，使用PCA降维和多种分类器评估，图模型在保持竞争力的同时大幅降低推理时间。
AI.motivation: 需要开发高效的点击诱饵检测方法，在保持检测性能的同时显著降低计算成本和推理时间，以支持实际应用中的快速检测需求。
AI.method: 结合OpenAI语义嵌入（使用PCA降维）和6个紧凑的启发式特征（捕捉风格和信息线索），使用XGBoost、GraphSAGE和GCN三种分类器进行评估。
AI.result: 简化特征设计导致F1分数略有下降，但图模型（GraphSAGE、GCN）实现了具有竞争力的性能，同时大幅减少了推理时间；高ROC-AUC值表明模型具有很强的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出的轻量级混合方法在保持良好检测性能的同时显著提升了效率，支持在不同决策阈值下可靠检测点击诱饵标题，具有实际应用价值。

title: Are we still able to recognize pearls? Machine-driven peer review and the risk to creativity: An explainable RAG-XAI detection framework with markers extraction
summary: The integration of large language models (LLMs) into peer review raises a concern beyond authorship and detection: the potential cascading automation of the entire editorial process. As reviews become partially or fully machine-generated, it becomes plausible that editorial decisions may also be delegated to algorithmic systems, leading to a fully automated evaluation pipeline. They risk reshaping the criteria by which scientific work is assessed. This paper argues that machine-driven assessment may systematically favor standardized, pattern-conforming research while penalizing unconventional and paradigm-shifting ideas that require contextual human judgment. We consider that this shift could lead to epistemic homogenization, where researchers are implicitly incentivized to optimize their work for algorithmic approval rather than genuine discovery. To address this risk, we introduce an explainable framework (RAG-XAI) for assessing review quality and detecting automated patterns using markers LLM extractor, aiming to preserve transparency, accountability and creativity in science. The proposed framework achieves near-perfect detection performance, with XGBoost, Random Forest and LightGBM reaching 99.61% accuracy, AUC-ROC above 0.999 and F1-scores of 0.9925 on the test set, while maintaining extremely low false positive rates (<0.23%) and false negative rates (~0.8%). In contrast, the logistic regression baseline performs substantially worse (89.97% accuracy, F1-score 0.8314). Feature importance and SHAP analyses identify absence of personal signals and repetition patterns as the dominant predictors. Additionally, the RAG component achieves 90.5% top-1 retrieval accuracy, with strong same-class clustering in the embedding space, further supporting the reliability of the framework's outputs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RAG-XAI框架，用于检测AI生成的同行评审，防止评审过程完全自动化导致科学评估标准异化，该框架在测试集上达到99.61%准确率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在同行评审中的应用可能导致整个编辑过程自动化，使编辑决策也委托给算法系统。这种机器驱动的评估可能系统性地偏向标准化、符合模式的研究，而惩罚需要人类情境判断的非传统和范式转变思想，导致认知同质化，研究人员可能为了算法批准而非真正发现而优化工作。
AI.method: 提出RAG-XAI可解释框架，用于评估评审质量和检测自动化模式。使用LLM提取器标记，结合XGBoost、Random Forest和LightGBM等机器学习模型，通过特征重要性和SHAP分析识别关键预测因子。RAG组件用于检索相关信息。
AI.result: 框架在测试集上达到近乎完美的检测性能：XGBoost、Random Forest和LightGBM达到99.61%准确率，AUC-ROC超过0.999，F1分数0.9925，同时保持极低的假阳性率(<0.23%)和假阴性率(~0.8%)。逻辑回归基线表现较差(89.97%准确率，F1分数0.8314)。特征分析显示缺乏个人信号和重复模式是主要预测因子。RAG组件达到90.5% top-1检索准确率。
AI.conclusion: RAG-XAI框架能有效检测AI生成的同行评审，有助于保持科学评估的透明度、问责制和创造性，防止评审过程完全自动化导致的认知同质化风险。

title: TOOLCAD: Exploring Tool-Using Large Language Models in Text-to-CAD Generation with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is an expert-level task that relies on long-horizon reasoning and coherent modeling actions. Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable advancements in enabling language agents to tackle real-world tasks. Notably, there has been no investigation into how tool-using LLMs optimally interact with CAD engines, hindering the emergence of LLM-based agentic text-to-CAD modeling systems. We propose ToolCAD, a novel agentic CAD framework deploying LLMs as tool-using agents for text-to-CAD generation. Furthermore, we introduce an interactive CAD modeling gym to rollout reasoning and tool-augmented interaction trajectories with the CAD engine, incorporating hybrid feedback and human supervision. Meanwhile, an end-to-end post-training strategy is presented to enable the LLM agent to elicit refined CAD Modeling Chain of Thought (CAD-CoT) and evolve into proficient CAD tool-using agents via online curriculum reinforcement learning. Our findings demonstrate ToolCAD fills the gap in adopting and training open-source LLMs for CAD tool-using agents, enabling them to perform comparably to proprietary models, paving the way for more accessible and robust autonomous text-to-CAD modeling systems.

AI.tldr: ToolCAD：一个基于LLM的代理式CAD框架，通过工具使用和强化学习训练，实现文本到CAD建模的自主生成系统
AI.motivation: CAD建模需要专家级的长时程推理和连贯操作，现有LLM在CAD工具使用方面缺乏研究，阻碍了基于LLM的文本到CAD建模系统的发展
AI.method: 提出ToolCAD框架，将LLM作为工具使用代理；创建交互式CAD建模环境来生成推理和工具增强的交互轨迹；采用混合反馈和人工监督；通过端到端后训练策略，利用在线课程强化学习训练LLM代理
AI.result: ToolCAD填补了开源LLM在CAD工具使用代理方面的空白，使其性能可与专有模型相媲美，为更易访问和鲁棒的自主文本到CAD建模系统铺平道路
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一个基于LLM的代理式CAD框架，通过工具使用和强化学习训练，实现了有效的文本到CAD建模，为自主CAD系统的发展提供了新途径

title: Training Data Size Sensitivity in Unsupervised Rhyme Recognition
summary: Rhyme is deceptively intuitive: what is or is not a rhyme is constructed historically, scholars struggle with rhyme classification, and people disagree on whether two words are rhymed or not. This complicates automated rhymed recognition and evaluation, especially in multilingual context. This article investigates how much training data is needed for reliable unsupervised rhyme recognition using RhymeTagger, a language-independent tool that identifies rhymes based on repeating patterns in poetry corpora. We evaluate its performance across seven languages (Czech, German, English, French, Italian, Russian, and Slovene), examining how training size and language differences affect accuracy. To set a realistic performance benchmark, we assess inter-annotator agreement on a manually annotated subset of poems and analyze factors contributing to disagreement in expert annotations: phonetic similarity between rhyming words and their distance from each other in a poem. We also compare RhymeTagger to three large language models using a one-shot learning strategy. Our findings show that, once provided with sufficient training data, RhymeTagger consistently outperforms human agreement, while LLMs lacking phonetic representation significantly struggle with the task.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了无监督押韵识别所需训练数据量，使用RhymeTagger工具在七种语言中评估性能，发现足够训练数据下RhymeTagger优于人类标注一致性，而缺乏语音表征的大语言模型表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 押韵识别具有挑战性：押韵标准具有历史建构性，学者对押韵分类存在争议，人们对于词语是否押韵意见不一。这导致在多语言环境下自动押韵识别和评估变得复杂，需要研究如何实现可靠的无监督押韵识别。
AI.method: 使用语言无关工具RhymeTagger，基于诗歌语料库中的重复模式识别押韵。在七种语言（捷克语、德语、英语、法语、意大利语、俄语和斯洛文尼亚语）中评估性能，分析训练数据量和语言差异对准确性的影响。建立人类标注一致性基准，分析导致专家标注分歧的因素（押韵词语音相似度和在诗歌中的距离）。同时将RhymeTagger与三种大语言模型进行一次性学习策略比较。
AI.result: 研究发现，一旦提供足够的训练数据，RhymeTagger在押韵识别任务上持续优于人类标注一致性。而缺乏语音表征的大语言模型在该任务上表现显著困难。研究还分析了影响人类标注分歧的因素，为押韵识别建立了现实的性能基准。
AI.conclusion: RhymeTagger在获得足够训练数据后能够实现可靠的无监督押韵识别，在多语言环境下表现优于人类一致性。大语言模型由于缺乏语音表征，在押韵识别任务上存在明显局限性。研究为跨语言押韵分析提供了实用工具和性能基准。

title: How Far Are Large Multimodal Models from Human-Level Spatial Action? A Benchmark for Goal-Oriented Embodied Navigation in Urban Airspace
summary: Large multimodal models (LMMs) show strong visual-linguistic reasoning but their capacity for spatial decision-making and action remains unclear. In this work, we investigate whether LMMs can achieve embodied spatial action like human through a challenging scenario: goal-oriented navigation in urban 3D spaces. We first spend over 500 hours constructing a dataset comprising 5,037 high-quality goal-oriented navigation samples, with an emphasis on 3D vertical actions and rich urban semantic information. Then, we comprehensively assess 17 representative models, including non-reasoning LMMs, reasoning LMMs, agent-based methods, and vision-language-action models. Experiments show that current LMMs exhibit emerging action capabilities, yet remain far from human-level performance. Furthermore, we reveal an intriguing phenomenon: navigation errors do not accumulate linearly but instead diverge rapidly from the destination after a critical decision bifurcation. The limitations of LMMs are investigated by analyzing their behavior at these critical decision bifurcations. Finally, we experimentally explore four promising directions for improvement: geometric perception, cross-view understanding, spatial imagination, and long-term memory. The project is available at: https://github.com/serenditipy-AC/Embodied-Navigation-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了大型多模态模型在3D城市空间中进行目标导向导航的具身空间行动能力，发现现有模型虽展现出初步行动能力，但远未达到人类水平，并揭示了导航错误在关键决策分叉点后快速发散的现象。
AI.motivation: 大型多模态模型在视觉-语言推理方面表现出色，但其空间决策和行动能力尚不明确。研究者希望通过挑战性的3D城市空间目标导向导航任务，系统评估LMMs的具身空间行动能力。
AI.method: 1. 构建包含5,037个高质量目标导向导航样本的数据集，重点关注3D垂直动作和丰富的城市语义信息；2. 全面评估17个代表性模型，包括非推理LMMs、推理LMMs、基于代理的方法和视觉-语言-动作模型；3. 分析导航错误在关键决策分叉点的行为模式；4. 探索几何感知、跨视图理解、空间想象和长期记忆四个改进方向。
AI.result: 1. 当前LMMs展现出初步的行动能力，但远未达到人类水平；2. 发现导航错误不会线性累积，而是在关键决策分叉点后快速偏离目的地；3. 通过分析关键决策分叉点的行为，揭示了LMMs的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 大型多模态模型在具身空间行动方面仍有很大提升空间，特别是在几何感知、跨视图理解、空间想象和长期记忆等关键能力上需要进一步改进。研究为评估和提升LMMs的导航能力提供了基准和方法论。

title: DSCA: Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment for Lifelong VLM Editing
summary: Model editing aims to update knowledge to add new concepts and change relevant information without retraining. Lifelong editing is a challenging task, prone to disrupting previously learned concepts, especially for Vision Language Models (VLMs), because sequential edits can lead to degraded reasoning and cross modal misalignment. Existing VLM knowledge editing methods based on gated adapters, activation edits, and parameter merging techniques address catastrophic forgetting seen in full fine tuning; however, they still operate in the shared representation space of the VLM, where concepts are entangled, so edits interfere with other non relevant concepts. We hypothesize that this instability persists because current methods algorithmically control edits via optimization rather than structurally separating knowledge. We introduce Dynamic Subspace Concept Alignment (DSCA) which by design mitigates this limitation by decomposing the representation space into a set of orthogonal semantic subspaces and proposing edits only in those transformed spaces. These subspaces are obtained through incremental clustering and PCA on joint vision language representations. This process structurally isolates concepts, enabling precise, non interfering edits by turning isolation from a soft training objective into an architectural property. The surgical edits are guided by a multi term loss function for maintaining task fidelity, edit locality, and cross modal alignment. With the base model frozen, our method achieves 98 percent single edit success, remains over 95 percent after 1000 sequential edits, lowers hallucination by 3 to 5 percent, and achieves the best backward transfer (BWT) scores on continual instruction tuning benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate DSCA state of the art stability and knowledge retention capability in continual lifelong editing across various datasets and benchmarks.

AI.tldr: DSCA方法通过将表示空间分解为正交语义子空间，在子空间中进行编辑，实现精确、无干扰的知识更新，在持续终身编辑中保持高成功率并减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM知识编辑方法在共享表示空间中操作，概念相互纠缠导致编辑干扰非相关概念，序列编辑会破坏先前学习的概念并导致推理能力下降和跨模态错位。
AI.method: 提出动态子空间概念对齐(DSCA)：通过增量聚类和PCA将联合视觉语言表示分解为多个正交语义子空间，在变换后的子空间中提出编辑，将隔离从软训练目标转变为架构属性，使用多术语损失函数保持任务保真度、编辑局部性和跨模态对齐。
AI.result: 单次编辑成功率98%，1000次序列编辑后仍保持95%以上成功率，幻觉降低3-5%，在持续指令调优基准上获得最佳向后转移(BWT)分数，在多个数据集和基准上展示了最先进的稳定性和知识保留能力。
AI.conclusion: DSCA通过结构性地分离知识表示，将概念隔离从优化目标转变为架构属性，有效解决了VLM持续终身编辑中的干扰问题，实现了精确、稳定的知识更新。

title: Self-Debias: Self-correcting for Debiasing Large Language Models
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning capabilities, inherent social biases often cascade throughout the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) process, leading to continuous "Bias Propagation". Existing debiasing methods primarily focus on static constraints or external interventions, failing to identify and interrupt this propagation once triggered. To address this limitation, we introduce Self-Debias, a progressive framework designed to instill intrinsic self-correction capabilities. Specifically, we reformulate the debiasing process as a strategic resource redistribution problem, treating the model's output probability mass as a limited resource to be reallocated from biased heuristics to unbiased reasoning paths. Unlike standard preference optimization which applies broad penalties, Self-Debias employs a fine-grained trajectory-level objective subject to dynamic debiasing constraints. This enables the model to selectively revise biased reasoning suffixes while preserving valid contextual prefixes. Furthermore, we integrate an online self-improvement mechanism utilizing consistency filtering to autonomously synthesize supervision signals. With merely 20k annotated samples, Self-Debias activates efficient self-correction, achieving superior debiasing performance while preserving general reasoning capabilities without continuous external oversight.

AI.tldr: Self-Debias框架通过将去偏过程重新定义为战略资源再分配问题，在CoT推理中实现内在自我纠正，仅需少量标注样本即可有效中断偏见传播。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在推理过程中存在社会偏见在思维链中持续传播的问题，现有去偏方法主要关注静态约束或外部干预，无法在偏见触发后识别和中断这种传播。
AI.method: 将去偏过程重新定义为战略资源再分配问题，将模型输出概率质量视为有限资源，从偏见启发式重新分配到无偏见推理路径；采用细粒度的轨迹级目标，结合动态去偏约束；集成在线自我改进机制，利用一致性过滤自主合成监督信号。
AI.result: 仅需20k标注样本，Self-Debias就能激活高效自我纠正，在保持一般推理能力的同时实现优越的去偏性能，无需持续外部监督。
AI.conclusion: Self-Debias框架通过内在自我纠正机制有效解决了LLM推理中的偏见传播问题，为去偏方法提供了新的思路，能够在保持模型推理能力的同时实现高效去偏。

title: PASK: Toward Intent-Aware Proactive Agents with Long-Term Memory
summary: Proactivity is a core expectation for AGI. Prior work remains largely confined to laboratory settings, leaving a clear gap in real-world proactive agent: depth, complexity, ambiguity, precision and real-time constraints. We study this setting, where useful intervention requires inferring latent needs from ongoing context and grounding actions in evolving user memory under latency and long-horizon constraints. We first propose DD-MM-PAS (Demand Detection, Memory Modeling, Proactive Agent System) as a general paradigm for streaming proactive AI agent. We instantiate this paradigm in Pask, with streaming IntentFlow model for DD, a hybrid memory (workspace, user, global) for long-term MM, PAS infra framework and introduce how these components form a closed loop. We also introduce LatentNeeds-Bench, a real-world benchmark built from user-consented data and refined through thousands of rounds of human editing. Experiments show that IntentFlow matches leading Gemini3-Flash models under latency constraints, while identifying deeper user intent.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DD-MM-PAS框架用于构建实时主动AI代理，包含需求检测、记忆建模和主动代理系统，并在Pask系统中实现，使用IntentFlow模型进行流式需求检测，混合记忆系统，以及LatentNeeds-Bench真实世界基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有主动代理研究主要局限于实验室环境，缺乏处理真实世界场景中深度、复杂性、模糊性、精确性和实时约束的能力。需要从持续上下文中推断潜在需求，并在延迟和长时程约束下将行动基于不断演化的用户记忆。
AI.method: 提出DD-MM-PAS（需求检测、记忆建模、主动代理系统）作为流式主动AI代理的通用范式。在Pask系统中实例化该范式：使用流式IntentFlow模型进行需求检测；采用混合记忆系统（工作空间、用户、全局）进行长期记忆建模；构建PAS基础设施框架，形成闭环系统。
AI.result: 实验显示，在延迟约束下，IntentFlow模型性能与领先的Gemini3-Flash模型相当，同时能够识别更深层次的用户意图。建立了LatentNeeds-Bench真实世界基准，基于用户同意数据并通过数千轮人工编辑精炼。
AI.conclusion: DD-MM-PAS框架为构建真实世界主动AI代理提供了有效范式，能够处理复杂、模糊的实时场景，识别深层用户需求，并在延迟约束下保持高性能，推进了主动代理从实验室到实际应用的转化。

title: Lighting-grounded Video Generation with Renderer-based Agent Reasoning
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in video generation, but their controllability remains a major limitation. Key scene factors such as layout, lighting, and camera trajectory are often entangled or only weakly modeled, restricting their applicability in domains like filmmaking and virtual production where explicit scene control is essential. We present LiVER, a diffusion-based framework for scene-controllable video generation. To achieve this, we introduce a novel framework that conditions video synthesis on explicit 3D scene properties, supported by a new large-scale dataset with dense annotations of object layout, lighting, and camera parameters. Our method disentangles these properties by rendering control signals from a unified 3D representation. We propose a lightweight conditioning module and a progressive training strategy to integrate these signals into a foundational video diffusion model, ensuring stable convergence and high fidelity. Our framework enables a wide range of applications, including image-to-video and video-to-video synthesis where the underlying 3D scene is fully editable. To further enhance usability, we develop a scene agent that automatically translates high-level user instructions into the required 3D control signals. Experiments show that LiVER achieves state-of-the-art photorealism and temporal consistency while enabling precise, disentangled control over scene factors, setting a new standard for controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: LiVER是一个基于扩散模型的场景可控视频生成框架，通过3D场景表示解耦布局、光照和相机轨迹等关键因素，实现精确的场景控制。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在视频生成方面取得了显著进展，但其可控性仍然有限。关键场景因素如布局、光照和相机轨迹往往纠缠在一起或仅被弱建模，限制了在电影制作和虚拟制作等需要明确场景控制领域的应用。
AI.method: 提出LiVER框架，通过统一的3D场景表示渲染控制信号，使用轻量级条件模块和渐进式训练策略将这些信号集成到基础视频扩散模型中。还开发了场景代理，将高级用户指令自动转换为所需的3D控制信号。
AI.result: 实验表明，LiVER在实现最先进的光照真实性和时间一致性的同时，能够对场景因素进行精确的解耦控制，为可控视频生成设定了新标准。
AI.conclusion: LiVER通过解耦3D场景属性实现了高度可控的视频生成，支持图像到视频和视频到视频合成，其中底层3D场景完全可编辑，为电影制作和虚拟生产等应用提供了强大的工具。

title: HyperMem: Hypergraph Memory for Long-Term Conversations
summary: Long-term memory is essential for conversational agents to maintain coherence, track persistent tasks, and provide personalized interactions across extended dialogues. However, existing approaches as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and graph-based memory mostly rely on pairwise relations, which can hardly capture high-order associations, i.e., joint dependencies among multiple elements, causing fragmented retrieval. To this end, we propose HyperMem, a hypergraph-based hierarchical memory architecture that explicitly models such associations using hyperedges. Particularly, HyperMem structures memory into three levels: topics, episodes, and facts, and groups related episodes and their facts via hyperedges, unifying scattered content into coherent units. Leveraging this structure, we design a hybrid lexical-semantic index and a coarse-to-fine retrieval strategy, supporting accurate and efficient retrieval of high-order associations. Experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show that HyperMem achieves state-of-the-art performance with 92.73% LLM-as-a-judge accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of HyperMem for long-term conversations.

AI.tldr: HyperMem：基于超图的分层记忆架构，通过超边显式建模多元素间的高阶关联，解决传统方法中碎片化检索问题，在长对话任务中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有对话记忆方法（如RAG和图记忆）主要依赖成对关系，难以捕捉多元素间的高阶关联，导致检索内容碎片化，影响长对话的连贯性和个性化交互。
AI.method: 提出超图分层记忆架构，包含主题、情节、事实三个层级，通过超边将相关情节及其事实分组为连贯单元；设计混合词义-语义索引和粗到细检索策略，实现高阶关联的准确高效检索。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准测试中达到92.73%的LLM-as-a-judge准确率，实现最先进性能，证明HyperMem在长对话任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HyperMem通过超图显式建模高阶关联，解决了传统记忆方法的碎片化检索问题，为长对话系统提供了更连贯、个性化的记忆管理方案。

title: Evaluating Counterfactual Explanation Methods on Incomplete Inputs
summary: Existing algorithms for generating Counterfactual Explanations (CXs) for Machine Learning (ML) typically assume fully specified inputs. However, real-world data often contains missing values, and the impact of these incomplete inputs on the performance of existing CX methods remains unexplored. To address this gap, we systematically evaluate recent CX generation methods on their ability to provide valid and plausible counterfactuals when inputs are incomplete. As part of this investigation, we hypothesize that robust CX generation methods will be better suited to address the challenge of providing valid and plausible counterfactuals when inputs are incomplete. Our findings reveal that while robust CX methods achieve higher validity than non-robust ones, all methods struggle to find valid counterfactuals. These results motivate the need for new CX methods capable of handling incomplete inputs.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了在输入数据不完整情况下生成反事实解释的现有方法，发现即使鲁棒性方法表现更好，所有方法都难以找到有效的反事实，凸显了需要开发能处理缺失值的新方法的必要性。
AI.motivation: 现实世界数据常包含缺失值，但现有反事实解释生成方法通常假设输入完全指定，这些方法在不完整输入下的性能影响尚未被探索，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 系统评估近期反事实解释生成方法在输入不完整情况下提供有效且合理反事实的能力，假设鲁棒性方法更适合处理不完整输入的挑战。
AI.result: 研究发现鲁棒性反事实方法比非鲁棒方法获得更高的有效性，但所有方法都难以找到有效的反事实解释。
AI.conclusion: 需要开发能够处理不完整输入的新反事实解释方法，以应对现实世界数据中普遍存在的缺失值问题。

title: Behavior-Aware Item Modeling via Dynamic Procedural Solution Representations for Knowledge Tracing
summary: Knowledge Tracing (KT) aims to predict learners' future performance from past interactions. While recent KT approaches have improved via learning item representations aligned with Knowledge Components, they overlook the procedural dynamics of problem solving. We propose Behavior-Aware Item Modeling (BAIM), a framework that enriches item representations by integrating dynamic procedural solution information. BAIM leverages a reasoning language model to decompose each item's solution into four problem-solving stages (i.e., understand, plan, carry out, and look back), pedagogically grounded in Polya's framework. Specifically, it derives stage-level representations from per-stage embedding trajectories, capturing latent signals beyond surface features. To reflect learner heterogeneity, BAIM adaptively routes these stage-wise representations, introducing a context-conditioned mechanism within a KT backbone, allowing different procedural stages to be emphasized for different learners. Experiments on XES3G5M and NIPS34 show that BAIM consistently outperforms strong pretraining-based baselines, achieving particularly large gains under repeated learner interactions.

AI.tldr: BAIM框架通过整合解题过程信息来丰富知识追踪中的题目表示，利用推理语言模型将解题分解为四个阶段，并根据学习者特征自适应调整阶段权重，显著提升了预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识追踪方法虽然通过学习与知识组件对齐的题目表示有所改进，但忽略了问题解决的程序性动态过程。需要更丰富的题目表示来捕捉解题过程中的潜在信号。
AI.method: 提出行为感知题目建模（BAIM）框架：1）使用推理语言模型将每个题目的解题过程分解为理解、计划、执行、回顾四个阶段；2）从每个阶段的嵌入轨迹中提取阶段级表示；3）引入上下文条件机制，在知识追踪骨干网络中自适应路由这些阶段表示，为不同学习者强调不同的解题阶段。
AI.result: 在XES3G5M和NIPS34数据集上的实验表明，BAIM持续优于基于预训练的强基线方法，在重复学习者交互场景下取得了特别大的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合程序性解题信息并考虑学习者异质性，BAIM框架能够更有效地建模学习者的知识状态，为知识追踪提供了更丰富的题目表示方法。

title: Wiring the 'Why': A Unified Taxonomy and Survey of Abductive Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Regardless of its foundational role in human discovery and sense-making, abductive reasoning--the inference of the most plausible explanation for an observation--has been relatively underexplored in Large Language Models (LLMs). Despite the rapid advancement of LLMs, the exploration of abductive reasoning and its diverse facets has thus far been disjointed rather than cohesive. This paper presents the first survey of abductive reasoning in LLMs, tracing its trajectory from philosophical foundations to contemporary AI implementations. To address the widespread conceptual confusion and disjointed task definitions prevalent in the field, we establish a unified two-stage definition that formally categorizes prior work. This definition disentangles abduction into \textit{Hypothesis Generation}, where models bridge epistemic gaps to produce candidate explanations, and \textit{Hypothesis Selection}, where the generated candidates are evaluated and the most plausible explanation is chosen. Building upon this foundation, we present a comprehensive taxonomy of the literature, categorizing prior work based on their abductive tasks, datasets, underlying methodologies, and evaluation strategies. In order to ground our framework empirically, we conduct a compact benchmark study of current LLMs on abductive tasks, together with targeted comparative analyses across model sizes, model families, evaluation styles, and the distinct generation-versus-selection task typologies. Moreover, by synthesizing recent empirical results, we examine how LLM performance on abductive reasoning relates to deductive and inductive tasks, providing insights into their broader reasoning capabilities. Our analysis reveals critical gaps in current approaches--from static benchmark design and narrow domain coverage to narrow training frameworks and limited mechanistic understanding of abductive processes...

AI.tldr: 本文首次对大型语言模型中的溯因推理进行了系统性综述，建立了统一的两阶段定义框架，并对现有文献进行了全面分类和基准测试分析。
AI.motivation: 溯因推理在人类发现和意义建构中具有基础性作用，但在大型语言模型中的研究相对不足且分散。当前领域存在概念混淆和任务定义不统一的问题，需要建立系统性的分析框架。
AI.method: 提出了统一的两阶段定义框架：假设生成（填补认知空白产生候选解释）和假设选择（评估并选择最合理的解释）。基于此建立了全面的文献分类法，并按任务、数据集、方法和评估策略分类。同时进行了基准测试研究，比较不同模型规模、家族、评估风格和任务类型。
AI.result: 分析揭示了当前方法的多个关键缺陷：静态基准设计、领域覆盖狭窄、训练框架有限、对溯因过程的机制理解不足。通过综合实证结果，探讨了LLM在溯因推理任务上的表现与演绎和归纳任务的关系。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个关于LLM中溯因推理的系统性综述，建立了统一的分析框架，识别了研究空白，并为理解LLM的推理能力提供了新见解，为未来研究奠定了基础。

title: DP-DeGauss: Dynamic Probabilistic Gaussian Decomposition for Egocentric 4D Scene Reconstruction
summary: Egocentric video is crucial for next-generation 4D scene reconstruction, with applications in AR/VR and embodied AI. However, reconstructing dynamic first-person scenes is challenging due to complex ego-motion, occlusions, and hand-object interactions. Existing decomposition methods are ill-suited, assuming fixed viewpoints or merging dynamics into a single foreground. To address these limitations, we introduce DP-DeGauss, a dynamic probabilistic Gaussian decomposition framework for egocentric 4D reconstruction. Our method initializes a unified 3D Gaussian set from COLMAP priors, augments each with a learnable category probability, and dynamically routes them into specialized deformation branches for background, hands, or object modeling. We employ category-specific masks for better disentanglement and introduce brightness and motion-flow control to improve static rendering and dynamic reconstruction. Extensive experiments show that DP-DeGauss outperforms baselines by +1.70dB in PSNR on average with SSIM and LPIPS gains. More importantly, our framework achieves the first and state-of-the-art disentanglement of background, hand, and object components, enabling explicit, fine-grained separation, paving the way for more intuitive ego scene understanding and editing.

AI.tldr: DP-DeGauss：首个动态概率高斯分解框架，用于解决第一人称视角视频中背景、手部和物体的精细分离问题，实现4D场景重建
AI.motivation: 第一人称视频对于下一代4D场景重建至关重要，但现有分解方法不适合动态第一人称场景，它们要么假设固定视角，要么将所有动态元素合并为单一前景，无法处理复杂的自我运动、遮挡和手-物交互
